title.zh: 卷三十三 本紀第三十三 孝宗一
title.raw: 卷三十三 本紀第三十三 孝宗一 Volume 33 Annals 33: Xiaozong 1

sentences.zh: 及元懿太子薨，高宗未有後，而昭慈聖獻皇后亦自江西還行在，後嘗感異夢，密爲高宗言之，高宗大寤。

translations.literal: When the Yuanyi Crown Prince died, Gaozong had no heir, and Empress Zhao the Sacred and Benevolent also returned to the mobile court from Jiangxi. The empress had once been moved by a strange dream and told Gaozong of it in secret; Gaozong was greatly awakened.
translations.idiomatic: After Crown Prince Yuanyi died, Gaozong still had no heir. Empress Zhao, the Sacred and Benevolent, had also returned to the court-in-exile from Jiangxi. She had had a remarkable dream and confided it to Gaozong in private; he was deeply stirred.

sentences.zh: 會右僕射范宗尹亦造膝以請，高宗曰：「太祖以神武定天下，子孫不得享之，遭時多艱，零落可憫。

translations.literal: At that time the Right Vice Director Fan Zongyin also came close to his knee to request it. Gaozong said: 'Taizu with divine martial prowess settled the realm; his descendants cannot enjoy it—meeting many hardships of the age, scattered and pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: About then Fan Zongyin, vice director of the Right, came forward in person to urge the same course. Gaozong said, 'Taizu with his godlike prowess brought the realm under his sway, yet his line could not hold what he won—battered by hard times until his kin were scattered and pitiable.

sentences.zh: 朕若不法仁宗，爲天下計，何以慰在天之靈！

translations.literal: If I do not take Emperor Renzong as my model, planning for the realm, how can I comfort the spirit in Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: If I do not follow Emperor Renzong's example and act for the good of the realm, how can I answer to Heaven above!

sentences.zh: 」於是詔選太祖之後。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict was issued to select from among Taizu's descendants.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued to choose an heir from among Taizu's descendants.

sentences.zh: 同知樞密院事李回曰：「藝祖不以大位私其子，發于至誠。

translations.literal: The Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Li Hui said: 'The Founding Emperor did not keep the supreme position for his own son; it sprang from utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hui, associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, said, 'Our founding emperor refused to reserve the throne for his own son—that came from the purest sincerity.

sentences.zh: 陛下爲天下遠慮，合于藝祖，可以昭格天命。

translations.literal: Your Majesty plans far ahead for the realm; this accords with the Founding Emperor and can make manifest Heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's farsighted concern for the realm matches the Founding Emperor's spirit and can win Heaven's approval.

sentences.zh: 」參知政事張守曰：「藝祖諸子，不聞失德，而傳位太宗，過堯、舜遠甚。

translations.literal: The Vice Director Zhang Shou said: 'Among the Founding Emperor's sons, none is said to have lost virtue, yet he passed the throne to Emperor Taizong—far surpassing Yao and Shun.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Zhang Shou said, 'None of the Founding Emperor's sons was known for moral failure, yet he handed the throne to Emperor Taizong—a deed that puts even Yao and Shun in the shade.

sentences.zh: 」高宗曰：「此事不難行，朕于'伯'字行中選擇，庶幾昭穆順序。

translations.literal: Gaozong said: 'This matter is not hard to carry out; I shall choose from among those in the generation of the character bo, so that the zhao-mu order may be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong said, 'This is not hard to do. I will choose from the generation marked by the character bo, so that the ancestral order of zhao and mu may be kept straight.

sentences.zh: 」而上虞丞婁寅亮亦上書言：「昌陵之後，寂寥無聞，僅同民庶。

translations.literal: The Assistant Magistrate of Shangyu Lou Yinliang also submitted a memorial saying: 'After Changling, there is silence and no report—barely the same as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Yinliang, assistant magistrate of Shangyu, also memorialized the throne: 'Taizu's line at Changling has fallen so quiet that his descendants are scarcely distinguishable from common folk.

sentences.zh: 藝祖在上，莫肯顧歆，此金人所以未悔禍也。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor above will not deign to look with favor; this is why the Jurchens have not yet repented of their calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu in Heaven will not look upon us with favor—and that is why the Jurchens have not yet turned from the ruin they have wrought.

sentences.zh: 望陛下于'伯'字行內選太祖諸孫有賢德者。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will select from within the generation of the character bo a worthy and virtuous grandson of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to choose, from among the bo generation, a grandson of Taizu who is gifted with virtue.

sentences.zh: 」高宗讀之，大感歎。

translations.literal: Gaozong read it and was greatly moved to sigh.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong read the memorial, he was deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年五月，選帝育於禁中。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Shaoxing, the Emperor was selected and reared within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shaoxing 2, the boy who would become emperor was chosen and raised inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，除和州防御使，賜名瑗。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, he was appointed Defender of Hezhou and given the name Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year three he was made Defender of Hezhou and given the name Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改貴州。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, he was promoted to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day his post was raised to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，用左僕射趙鼎議，立書院宮中教之，既成，遂以爲資善堂。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, following the proposal of Left Vice Director Zhao Ding, an academy was established in the palace to teach him; when it was completed, it was named the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year five, on Left Vice Director Zhao Ding's advice, a school was set up in the palace for his instruction; when it was finished, it was called the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.

sentences.zh: 帝讀書強記，天資特異。

translations.literal: The Emperor read with a powerful memory; his natural endowment was exceptionally marked.
translations.idiomatic: He read with a formidable memory; his native gifts were extraordinary.

sentences.zh: 己亥，制授保慶軍節度使，封建國公。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, by imperial commission he was made Military Commissioner of Baojing and enfeoffed as Duke of Jianguo.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day he was commissioned Military Commissioner of Baojing and enfeoffed as Duke of Jianguo.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，聽讀資善堂，以徽猷閣待制範沖兼詡善，起居郎朱震兼贊讀，高宗命帝見沖、震皆拜。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the sixth month, he was permitted to attend lectures at the Hall of Cultivating Goodness; Fan Chong, awaiting orders at the Hall of Imperial Writings, was made concurrently Instructor in Goodness, and Zhu Zhen, Recorder of the Emperor, was made concurrently Lecturer; Gaozong ordered the Emperor to bow when he saw Chong and Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's jiyou day he was allowed to study at the Hall of Cultivating Goodness. Fan Chong of the Imperial Writings Hall was named instructor, and Zhu Zhen, court recorder, was named lecturer; Gaozong ordered the young heir to bow to Chong and Zhen when he met them.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月丁酉，加檢校少保，封普安郡王。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year, on the day dingyou, he was made Junior Guardian by inspection and enfeoffed as Prince of Pu'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year twelve, on the dingyou day, he was made Junior Guardian by inspection and enfeoffed as Prince of Pu'an.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，出閣就外第。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renyin, he left the palace and took up residence at an outer mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renyin day, he left the inner palace and moved to an outer residence.

sentences.zh: 十三年九月，秀王歿於秀州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year, the Prince of Xiu died at Xiu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year thirteen the Prince of Xiu died at Xiu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月庚辰，用廷臣議，聽解官行服。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year, on the day gengchen, following court discussion, he was permitted to resign his office and observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year fourteen, on the gengchen day, the court agreed that he might leave office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月乙巳，免喪，還舊官。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixteenth year, on the day yisi, mourning ended and he returned to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year sixteen, on the yisi day, mourning ended and he resumed his former post.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月戊午，改常德軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, on the day wuwu, he was made Military Commissioner of Changde.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year seventeen, on the wuwu day, he was made Military Commissioner of Changde.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，衢州盜起，秦檜遣殿前司將官辛立將千人捕之，不以聞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, bandits rose in Qu Prefecture; Qin Hui sent Palace Front Office officer Xin Li with a thousand men to capture them and did not report it.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty-four bandits broke out in Quzhou. Qin Hui sent Xin Li of the Palace Front Office with a thousand troops to suppress them and said nothing to the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝入侍言之，高宗大驚。

translations.literal: The Emperor entered to attend him and spoke of it; Gaozong was greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: When the heir came in to wait on Gaozong and told him, Gaozong was deeply alarmed.

sentences.zh: 明日，以問檜，檜謂不足煩聖慮，故不敢聞，俟朝夕盜平則奏矣。

translations.literal: The next day, when he asked Qin Hui, Qin Hui said it was not worth troubling the sage's concern, so he had not reported it; he would memorialize once the bandits were pacified morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Gaozong questioned Qin Hui, who replied that the matter was too slight to trouble the emperor and that he had withheld word until the rebels could be crushed from dawn to dusk.

sentences.zh: 檜退，知爲帝言，忌之。

translations.literal: When Qin Hui withdrew, knowing the Emperor had spoken, he resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui left the audience knowing the heir had spoken against him and bore a grudge.

sentences.zh: 及檜疾篤，其家秘不以聞，謀以子熺代相，帝又密啟高宗破其奸。

translations.literal: When Qin Hui's illness grew grave, his family kept it secret and did not report it, plotting to have his son Qi succeed as chief minister; the Emperor again secretly informed Gaozong and broke their treachery.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin Hui fell gravely ill, his household hid the fact and plotted to install his son Qi as chief minister; the heir again secretly warned Gaozong and foiled the scheme.

sentences.zh: 三十年二月癸酉，立爲皇子，更名瑋。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirtieth year, on the day guiyou, he was established as imperial son and renamed Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year thirty, on the guiyou day, he was formally adopted as imperial son and renamed Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔下。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day the edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 丙子，制授甯國軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封建王。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, by commission he was made Military Commissioner of Ningguo and Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial honors as the Three Excellencies, and advanced to Prince of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day he was commissioned Military Commissioner of Ningguo and Grand Preceptor with Three Excellencies honors, and promoted to Prince of Jian.

sentences.zh: 制出，中外大悅。

translations.literal: When the commission was issued, inside and outside the court were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When the appointment was announced, court and country rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 四月，賜字元瑰。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, the courtesy name Yuangui was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was given the courtesy name Yuangui.

sentences.zh: 三十一年十月壬子，以明堂恩，改鎮南軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the thirty-first year, on the day renzi, by grace of the Bright Hall he was made Military Commissioner of Zhennan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year thirty-one, on the renzi day, he was made Military Commissioner of Zhennan as part of the Bright Hall amnesty.

sentences.zh: 先是，金人犯邊，高宗下詔親征，而兩淮失守，朝臣多陳退避之計，帝不勝其憤，請率師爲前驅。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Jurchens invaded the border, Gaozong issued an edict for a personal campaign; the two Huai regions were lost, and court ministers mostly urged plans of withdrawal; the Emperor could not bear his anger and requested to lead the army as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Jurchens raided the frontier, Gaozong had proclaimed his own expedition; after the Huai region fell, many ministers urged retreat. The heir, unable to contain his anger, asked to lead the vanguard himself.

sentences.zh: 直講史浩以疾在告，聞之亟入，爲帝言，太子不宜將兵，乃爲草奏，因中宮以進，請衛從以共子職。

translations.literal: The Lecturer Shi Hao, ill and on leave, heard of it and hurried in; he told the Emperor the crown prince ought not command troops, and drafted a memorial, sending it in through the inner palace, asking to attend as guard and share the son's duty.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hao, lecturer on leave for illness, heard of this and rushed to court. He told the heir a crown prince must not take the field, drafted a memorial, and had it sent in through the inner palace, offering to serve as escort in a son's place.

sentences.zh: 高宗因亦欲帝遍識諸將，十二月，遂扈蹕如金陵。

translations.literal: Gaozong also wished the Emperor to become acquainted with all the generals; in the twelfth month he therefore accompanied the imperial procession to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong also wanted the heir to know the generals personally; in the twelfth month he therefore accompanied the court to Jinling.

sentences.zh: 三十二年五月甲子，立爲皇太子，改名昚。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, on the day jiazi of the fifth month, he was established as crown prince and renamed Shen.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-two, on the fifth month's jiazi day, he was made crown prince and renamed Shen.

sentences.zh: 初，高宗久有禪位之意，嘗以諭帝，帝流涕固辭，會有邊事不果。

translations.literal: Earlier, Gaozong had long intended to abdicate; he had once told the Emperor, who wept and firmly declined; because of border affairs it did not come to pass.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong had long meant to abdicate and had once told the heir so; the prince wept and refused, and border troubles kept the plan from being carried out.

sentences.zh: 及歸自金陵，陳康伯求去，高宗復以倦勤諭之。

translations.literal: When he returned from Jinling, Chen Kangbo asked to leave office; Gaozong again urged him with weariness of rule.
translations.idiomatic: After returning from Jinling, Chen Kangbo asked to resign; Gaozong again spoke of his weariness of governing.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人唐文若聞而請對，言不宜急遽，故先下建儲之詔，賜名燁。

translations.literal: The Secretariat Drafter Tang Wenruo heard and requested an audience, saying it should not be rushed; therefore the edict establishing the heir was issued first, and the name Ye was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Wenruo of the Secretariat, hearing this, sought an audience and urged that nothing be rushed; an edict establishing the heir was issued first, and he was given the name Ye.

sentences.zh: 監察御史周必大密與康伯言，與唐昭宗名同音，不可。

translations.literal: The Investigating Censor Zhou Bida secretly told Kangbo that it was homophonous with Emperor Zhaozong's name and could not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Zhou Bida quietly told Kangbo the name matched Emperor Zhaozong's in sound and could not stand.

sentences.zh: 詔別擬進，乃定今名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered another name proposed; the present name was then fixed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for a new name, and the one he bears today was chosen.

sentences.zh: 既又命學士承旨洪遵爲太子擇字，遵擬四字以進，皆不稱旨。

translations.literal: Again he ordered Academician Expositor Hong Zun to choose a courtesy name for the crown prince; Zun proposed four characters and presented them; none pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong then ordered Hong Zun, academician expositor, to select a courtesy name for the crown prince. Zun submitted four choices; none satisfied the emperor.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，御筆賜字元永。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiaxu, the imperial brush bestowed the courtesy name Yuanyong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiaxu day, the emperor himself wrote the courtesy name Yuanyong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，內降御劄：「皇太子可即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an imperial letter descended from within: 'The crown prince may immediately ascend the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day an imperial letter came down from within: 'The crown prince shall at once take the throne.

sentences.zh: 朕稱太上皇帝，退處德壽宮；

translations.literal: I shall style myself Retired Emperor and withdraw to De Shou Palace;
translations.idiomatic: I shall take the title Retired Emperor and withdraw to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity;

sentences.zh: 皇后稱太上皇后。

translations.literal: the empress shall style herself Retired Empress.'
translations.idiomatic: the empress shall be styled Retired Empress.'

sentences.zh: 」丙子，遣中使召帝入禁中，面諭之，帝又推遜不受，即趨側殿門，欲還東宮，高宗勉諭再三，乃止。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, an inner envoy was sent to summon the Emperor into the palace; he was instructed face to face, but again declined and would not accept; he at once hurried to the side hall gate, wishing to return to the Eastern Palace; Gaozong urged him again and again before he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day an inner envoy summoned the heir into the palace and instructed him in person, but he again refused the throne and made for the side gate, intending to return to the Eastern Palace; only after Gaozong urged him repeatedly did he stay.

sentences.zh: 於是高宗出御紫宸殿，輔臣奏事畢，高宗還宮。

translations.literal: Thereupon Gaozong came out to preside at the Hall of Purple Brightness; the chief ministers finished presenting business, and Gaozong returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong then appeared at the Hall of Purple Brightness; when the chief ministers had finished their business, he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 百官移班殿門外，拜詔畢，復入班殿庭。

translations.literal: The hundred officials shifted their formation outside the hall gate; when they had finished bowing to the edict, they re-entered formation in the hall courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: The officials moved their ranks outside the hall gate; after bowing to the edict they re-formed in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 頃之，內侍掖帝至御榻前，側立不坐，內侍扶掖至七八，乃略就坐。

translations.literal: Shortly after, inner attendants led the Emperor to the front of the imperial couch; he stood to the side and would not sit; inner attendants supported him seven or eight times before he barely took his seat.
translations.idiomatic: Soon inner attendants led the heir to the imperial couch; he stood aside and would not sit until they had steadied him seven or eight times, and even then he barely took the seat.

sentences.zh: 宰相率百僚稱賀，帝遽興。

translations.literal: The chief minister led the hundred officials in offering congratulations; the Emperor rose at once.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister led the officials in congratulation; the new emperor rose immediately.

sentences.zh: 輔臣升殿固請，帝愀然曰：「君父之命，出於獨斷。

translations.literal: The chief ministers ascended the hall and firmly requested him to be seated; the Emperor said with a troubled look: 'The command of lord and father proceeds from his sole decision.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers mounted the hall and pressed him to sit; with a troubled face he said, 'My father and sovereign's command was his alone to give.

sentences.zh: 然此大位，懼不克當。

translations.literal: Yet this great position—I fear I cannot bear it.'
translations.idiomatic: But this great burden—I fear I am not equal to it.'

sentences.zh: 」班退，太上皇帝即駕之德壽宮，帝服袍履，步出祥曦殿門，冒雨掖輦以行，及宮門弗止。

translations.literal: When the session ended, the Retired Emperor at once drove to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity; the Emperor wore robe and shoes, walked out the gate of the Hall of Auspicious Dawn, held the carriage in the rain, and would not stop at the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the audience ended, the retired emperor went at once to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity. The new emperor, in robe and shoes, walked out through the Hall of Auspicious Dawn, held the carriage through the rain, and would not halt at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 上皇麾謝再三，且令左右扶掖以還，顧曰：「吾付託得人，吾無憾矣。

translations.literal: The retired emperor waved thanks again and again, and ordered those at his side to support him back, looking back and saying: 'I have entrusted it to the right man; I have no regret.'
translations.idiomatic: The retired emperor waved him off again and again, had attendants help him back, and looking back said, 'I have placed it in worthy hands; I have no regret.'

sentences.zh: 」左右皆呼萬歲。

translations.literal: Those at his side all cried 'Ten thousand years!'
translations.idiomatic: Those around him shouted 'Long live the emperor!'

sentences.zh: 是日，詔有司議太上皇帝、太上皇后尊號以聞，在內諸司日輪官吏應奉德壽宮，增置，朝德壽宮提點、幹辦等官，德壽宮宿衛依皇城及宮門法。

translations.literal: That day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to deliberate on the honorific titles of Retired Emperor and Retired Empress and report; the inner offices were to rotate officials daily to attend the Palace of Virtuous Longevity, with additional posts; commissioners and administrators for the palace were added; guards at the Palace of Virtuous Longevity followed the laws for the Imperial City and palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict ordered the offices to draft honorific titles for the retired emperor and empress and report back; inner offices were to send officials in rotation daily to serve the Palace of Virtuous Longevity, with new posts added; commissioners and administrators were appointed; and the palace guard was regulated like that of the Imperial City.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 詔宰相率百官月兩朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the chief minister to lead the hundred officials in paying court to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity twice a month.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the chief minister to lead the officials in attending the retired emperor at his palace twice each month.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以即位告於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the accession was announced to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the accession was reported to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔五日一朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, an edict ordered court to be held at the Palace of Virtuous Longevity every five days.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day an edict fixed audiences with the retired emperor every five days.

sentences.zh: 以左武大夫龍大淵爲樞密副都承旨，武翼郎曾覿帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Long Dayuan of the Left Martial Grandee rank was made Deputy Chief Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Zeng Di of the Martial Wings rank was given charge of imperial equipage.
translations.idiomatic: Long Dayuan, Left Martial Grandee, was made deputy chief commissioner of military affairs; Zeng Di, Martial Wings officer, was given charge of imperial equipage.

sentences.zh: 癸未，始御後殿。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, he first presided at the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day he held court for the first time in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔中外士庶陳時政闕失。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered scholars and commoners throughout the court and country to memorialize shortcomings in current policy.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day an edict invited officials and subjects everywhere to report failings in government.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔進宰執官二等。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict ordered the chief and vice ministers promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day an edict raised the chief and vice ministers two grades.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔以太上皇不許五日一朝，自今月四朝。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict said that because the retired emperor did not permit audiences every five days, from this month there would be four audiences a month.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day an edict noted that the retired emperor would not accept audiences every five days; from that month audiences were set at four per month.

sentences.zh: 復除名勒停人胡銓官、知饒州。

translations.literal: Hu Quan, whose name had been struck and office suspended, was restored to office and made prefect of Rao.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Quan, who had been struck from the rolls and suspended, was restored to office and made prefect of Rao.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔有司月奉德壽宮緡錢十萬。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, an edict ordered the offices to supply the Palace of Virtuous Longevity one hundred thousand strings of cash each month.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day an edict fixed a monthly allowance of one hundred thousand strings of cash for the retired emperor's palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔罷四川市馬。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, an edict abolished the purchase of horses in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day an edict ended the Sichuan horse-purchase program.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔百官日一人入對。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, an edict ordered one official a day to enter for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day an edict required one official each day to attend for audience.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，蝗。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, locusts appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day locusts appeared.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上太上皇帝尊號曰光堯壽聖太上皇帝，太上皇后曰壽聖太上皇后。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the honorific title of the retired emperor was fixed as Retired Emperor Guangyao, Long-lived and Sage; that of the retired empress as Long-lived and Sage, Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the retired emperor was given the honorific Guangyao, Long-lived and Sage, Retired Emperor; the retired empress was styled Long-lived and Sage, Retired Empress.

sentences.zh: 乙未晦，金人屠原州。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month yihai, the Jurchens slaughtered Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the month, the Jurchens massacred Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，興州中軍統制吳挺復鞏州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuxu, Wu Ting, commander of the middle army of Xing Prefecture, recovered Gong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the wuxu day, Wu Ting, middle-army commander at Xingzhou, recovered Gongzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，判建康府張浚入見。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Zhang Jun, acting prefect of Jiankang, entered for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Zhang Jun, acting prefect of Jiankang, was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 以雨水、飛蝗，令侍從、台諫條上民間利害。

translations.literal: Because of rain floods and flying locusts, attendants and remonstrating censors were ordered to list harms and benefits to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Because of floods and locust swarms, attendants and remonstrating censors were ordered to set out the people's grievances.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔戒飭諸郡守臣。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict warned and admonished prefectural and circuit magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day an edict admonished prefects and circuit intendants.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以張浚爲少傅、江淮宣撫使，封魏國公。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Zhang Jun was made Junior Tutor and Pacification Commissioner of the Jiang-Huai region and enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Zhang Jun was made junior tutor and pacification commissioner for the Jiang-Huai region and enfeoffed Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以參知政事汪澈視師湖北、京西。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Vice Director Wang Che was sent to oversee the armies of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Vice Director Wang Che was dispatched to oversee the armies of Hubei and Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 遣劉珙等使金告即位。

translations.literal: Liu Qi and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to announce the accession.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi and others were sent to the Jin court to announce the new reign.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以四川宣撫使吳璘兼陝西河東路宣撫、招討使。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Wu Lin, Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan, was made concurrently Pacification and Recruiting Commissioner of the Shaanxi and Hedong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Wu Lin, Sichuan pacification commissioner, was also made pacification and recruiting commissioner for Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 追復岳飛元官，以禮改葬。

translations.literal: Yue Fei's original offices were posthumously restored, and he was reburied with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei's former ranks were posthumously restored and he was reburied with full honors.

sentences.zh: 是夜，地震，大風拔木。

translations.literal: That night there was an earthquake; a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: That night the earth shook and a fierce wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 己酉，有事於太廟、別廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, sacrifice was made at the Great Temple and the separate temples.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day sacrifice was offered at the Great Temple and the collateral shrines.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，馬軍司中軍統制趙撙、忠義軍統領皇甫倜復光州。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Zhao Zan, commander of the middle army of the Horse Army Office, and Huangfu Tong, commander of the Loyal and Righteous Army, recovered Guang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Zhao Zan, middle-army commander of the Horse Army Office, and Huangfu Tong, commander of the Loyal and Righteous Army, recovered Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, court was held at the Jingling Shrine of Offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day the emperor attended the Jingling Shrine of Offerings.

sentences.zh: 詔淮南諸州存恤淮北來歸之民，權免稅役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Huainan prefectures to succor the people who had come from north of the Huai and temporarily exempt them from tax and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Huainan prefectures to care for refugees from north of the Huai and temporarily exempt them from taxes and labor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以少保、保康軍節度使吳益爲少傅，太尉、甯武軍節度使吳蓋爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Wu Yi, Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Baokang, was made Junior Tutor; Wu Gai, Grand Marshal and Military Commissioner of Ningwu, was made Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial honors as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Wu Yi, junior guardian and Baokang commissioner, was made junior tutor; Wu Gai, grand marshal and Ningwu commissioner, was made grand preceptor with Three Excellencies honors.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，罷李寶措置海道。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Li Bao's commission over the sea route was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day Li Bao's sea-route command was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊午，恩平郡王璩入見。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the Prince of Enping, Zhao Qi, entered for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Zhao Qi, Prince of Enping, was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以御前軍器所仍隸工部。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Imperial Armory of the Inner Court was again placed under the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day the Imperial Armory was again subordinated to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔後省看詳中外上書，有可采者以聞。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, an edict ordered the Secretariat and Chancellery to review memorials from within and without the court and report what was worth adopting.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day an edict ordered the Secretariat and Chancellery to review public memorials and report whatever merited adoption.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以黃祖舜兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Huang Zuxun was made Acting Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Huang Zuxun was made acting vice director.

sentences.zh: 罷諸路聖節進奉。

translations.literal: The birthday tribute from all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Birthday tribute from all circuits was abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔李顯忠軍馬聽張浚節制。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Xianzhong's army and horses to heed Zhang Jun's command.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed Li Xianzhong's troops and horses under Zhang Jun's command.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，增將士戰傷死者推恩格。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the scale of favors for soldiers wounded or killed in battle was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day benefits for soldiers wounded or killed in battle were raised.

sentences.zh: 詔蠲四川積年逋負。

translations.literal: An edict remitted Sichuan's arrears accumulated over the years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict canceled Sichuan's long-standing tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑朔，四川馬軍統制高師中與金人戰于摧沙，敗死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month yichou, Gao Shizhong, commander of the Sichuan Horse Army, fought the Jurchens at Cuisha and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the first day yichou, Gao Shizhong, Sichuan horse-army commander, fought the Jurchens at Cuisha and was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吳璘與金人戰於德順軍。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Wu Lin fought the Jurchens at Deshun Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Wu Lin engaged the Jurchens at Deshun.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以翰林學士史浩爲參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Academician of the Hanlin Academy Shi Hao was made Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Shi Hao of the Hanlin Academy was made vice director.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，率群臣詣德壽宮，奉上太上皇帝、太上皇后尊號冊寶。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, he led the hundred officials to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity and presented the honorific registers and seals of the retired emperor and retired empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day he led the officials to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity to present the honorific registers and seals to the retired emperor and empress.

sentences.zh: 于亥，班寬恤事十八條。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, eighteen items of lenient relief were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day eighteen measures of lenient relief were announced.

sentences.zh: 起居舍人洪邁、知閣門事張掄坐奉使辱命罷。

translations.literal: Recorder Hong Mai and Commissioner of the Gate Office Zhang Lun were dismissed for disgracing the mission on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Mai, recorder, and Zhang Lun, gate commissioner, were dismissed for failing their embassy.

sentences.zh: 甲申，吳璘敗金人於北山。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Wu Lin defeated the Jurchens at North Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Wu Lin defeated the Jurchens at North Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，追復李光資政殿學土，趙鼎、範沖並還合得恩數。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Li Guang was posthumously restored as Academician of the Hall of Assisting Governance; Zhao Ding and Fan Chong were also restored to the favors due them.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Li Guang was posthumously restored as hall academician; Zhao Ding and Fan Chong were likewise restored to their proper honors.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以生日爲會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the birthday was made the Festival of Accumulated Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day the emperor's birthday was established as the Festival of Accumulated Celebration.

sentences.zh: 追冊故妃郭氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: The late consort Guo was posthumously enfeoffed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: The late Consort Guo was posthumously enfeoffed as empress.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，以子愭爲少保、永興軍節度使，進封鄧王；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiawu, the son Qi was made Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Yongxing and advanced to Prince of Deng;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiawu day, the son Qi was made junior guardian and Yongxing commissioner and advanced to Prince of Deng;

sentences.zh: 愷爲雄武軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封慶王；

translations.literal: Kai was made Military Commissioner of Xiongwu and Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial honors as the Three Excellencies and advanced to Prince of Qing;
translations.idiomatic: Kai was made Xiongwu commissioner and grand preceptor with Three Excellencies honors and advanced to Prince of Qing;

sentences.zh: 惇爲鎮洮軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封恭王。

translations.literal: Dun was made Military Commissioner of Zhentao and Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial honors as the Three Excellencies and advanced to Prince of Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Dun was made Zhentao commissioner and grand preceptor with Three Excellencies honors and advanced to Prince of Gong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金人攻德順軍東山堡，中軍將李庠戰死。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Jurchens attacked the eastern mountain fort of Deshun Army; the middle-army officer Li Xiang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the Jurchens attacked Deshun's eastern mountain fort; middle-army officer Li Xiang was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔開講日召輔臣觀講。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered that on lecture days the chief ministers be summoned to attend the lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day an edict required the chief ministers to attend imperial lectures on lecture days.

sentences.zh: 川、陝宣諭使虞允文以論邊事不合罷。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen, Commissioner for Proclamation of Sichuan and Shaanxi, was dismissed because his views on border affairs did not accord.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen, proclamation commissioner for Sichuan and Shaanxi, was dismissed when his border policy fell out of favor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔侍從、台諫舉知四川利害可爲都轉運使者。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, an edict ordered attendants and remonstrating censors to recommend men who understood Sichuan's interests and could serve as chief transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day an edict called on attendants and censors to nominate experts on Sichuan who could serve as chief transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以金人來索舊禮，詔宰執、侍從、台諫各陳應敵定論以聞。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, because the Jurchens came demanding the old ritual forms, an edict ordered the chief ministers, attendants, and censors each to set forth a settled policy for dealing with the enemy and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, when the Jurchens demanded restoration of the old tribute forms, an edict required chief ministers, attendants, and censors each to propose a firm policy and report.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔吳璘審度措置，保全川蜀。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict ordered Wu Lin to deliberate and arrange matters so as to preserve Sichuan and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day an edict charged Wu Lin to plan how to hold Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔纂錄勳臣名次。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict ordered the compilation and recording of the order of merit among meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day an edict ordered a register of meritorious ministers to be compiled.

sentences.zh: 丙午，轉補朱震、范衝子孫官。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the sons and grandsons of Zhu Zhen and Fan Chong were transferred to office.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day the sons and grandsons of Zhu Zhen and Fan Chong were given official posts.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，諡皇后郭氏曰恭懷。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the posthumous title of Empress Guo was fixed as Respectful and Cherished.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Empress Guo was given the posthumous name Respectful and Cherished.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，振淮東義兵及歸正人。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, loyal militia of Huai East and those who had returned to allegiance were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day loyal militia east of the Huai and men who had returned to Song allegiance were given relief.

sentences.zh: 以總領四川財賦軍馬錢糧王之望爲戶部侍郎、川陝宣諭使，仍命將調兵同防守興州川口。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang, Chief Administrator of Sichuan's finances, army horses, and grain, was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Commissioner for Proclamation of Sichuan and Shaanxi, and was also ordered to transfer troops to defend the river crossing at Xing Prefecture with the generals.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang, who oversaw Sichuan's finances and military supplies, was made vice revenue director and Sichuan-Shaanxi proclamation commissioner, and ordered to move troops with the generals to hold the Xingzhou river crossing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔虞允文赴吳璘軍議事。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, an edict ordered Yu Yunwen to go to Wu Lin's army to discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict sent Yu Yunwen to Wu Lin's headquarters for consultation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以吳璘爲少師。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Wu Lin was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Wu Lin was made junior preceptor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，詔朝臣舉堪監司、郡守者，戊辰，以岳陽軍節度使居廣開府儀同三司，史浩兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingyin, an edict ordered court officials to recommend men fit to serve as circuit commissioners and prefects; on the day wuchen, Ju Guang, Military Commissioner of Yueyang, was made Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial honors as the Three Excellencies, and Shi Hao was made Acting Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the bingyin day, an edict called for nominations of men fit for circuit and prefectural office; on the wuchen day Ju Guang of Yueyang was made grand preceptor with Three Excellencies honors, and Shi Hao was made acting associate military affairs director.

sentences.zh: 己巳，葉義問罷。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Ye Yiwen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Ye Yiwen was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 詔登聞鼓院毋沮抑進狀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Court of Imperial Complaints not to obstruct or suppress memorials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade the Court of Imperial Complaints to block memorials.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以恩平郡王璩爲少保。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the Prince of Enping, Zhao Qi, was made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Zhao Qi, Prince of Enping, was made junior guardian.

sentences.zh: 詔會慶節權免上壽。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that on the Festival of Accumulated Celebration the birthday congratulations be provisionally waived.
translations.idiomatic: An edict waived the usual birthday congratulations on the Festival of Accumulated Celebration.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔張浚、陳俊卿覆實諸將所陳功賞。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict ordered Zhang Jun and Chen Junqing to verify the merit rewards claimed by the generals.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day an edict charged Zhang Jun and Chen Junqing to verify the generals' claims for merit rewards.

sentences.zh: 改諡皇后郭氏曰安穆。

translations.literal: The posthumous title of Empress Guo was changed to Peaceful and Solemn.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Guo's posthumous name was changed to Peaceful and Solemn.

sentences.zh: 壬午，官岳飛孫六人。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, six grandsons of Yue Fei were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day six of Yue Fei's grandsons were given office.

sentences.zh: 甲申，契丹招討蕭鷓巴來奔。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the Khitan Pacification Commissioner Xiao Zheba came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day the Khitan pacification commissioner Xiao Zheba defected to Song.

sentences.zh: 金人攻德順城，吳璘擊走之，復遣兵追襲，遂爲所敗。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Deshun city; Wu Lin drove them off, then sent troops in pursuit and was in turn defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens attacked Deshun; Wu Lin repulsed them, pursued, and was himself defeated.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，升建州爲建寧府。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Jian Prefecture was promoted to Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Jianzhou was elevated to Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以資政殿學士張燾同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Zhang Tao, Academician of the Hall of Assisting Governance, was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Zhang Tao, hall academician, was made associate military affairs director.

sentences.zh: 己丑，安南都護、南平王同李天祚、闍婆國王悉里地茶蘭固野、占城國王鄒時巴蘭並加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Li Tianzuo, Protector-General of Annan and King of Nanping, King Silidichalanguoye of Java, and King Zoushibalan of Champa were all given increased substantive enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Li Tianzuo of Annan, the Javanese king Silidichalanguoye, and Champa's king Zoushibalan all received increased substantive fiefs.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，以蕭鷓巴爲忠州團練使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengzi, Xiao Zheba was made Regimental Commander of Zhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengzi day, Xiao Zheba was made regimental commander of Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金人攻水洛城。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Jurchens attacked Shuiluo city.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day the Jurchens attacked Shuiluo.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜忠義軍統制皇甫倜軍帛五千匹、綿萬兩。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Huangfu Tong, commander of the Loyal and Righteous Army, was given five thousand bolts of silk and ten thousand taels of cotton for his troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Huangfu Tong, Loyal and Righteous Army commander, was granted five thousand bolts of silk and ten thousand taels of cotton for his men.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔改明年爲隆興元年。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict changed the next year to the first year of Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day an edict proclaimed the next year as Longxing 1.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免楊存中所獻酒坊逋負錢四十萬緡。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the four hundred thousand strings of cash in arrears on the wine shops presented by Yang Cunzhong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day four hundred thousand strings of wine-shop debt presented by Yang Cunzhong were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，定內侍官額。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the quota for inner attendants was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day the establishment for palace eunuchs was fixed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，史浩免權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Shi Hao was relieved of his acting post at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Shi Hao left his acting military affairs post.

sentences.zh: 裁定文武臣宮觀、嶽廟員數。

translations.literal: The numbers of civil and military officials holding sinecures at palaces and mountain temples were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas were set for civil and military officials holding palace and temple sinecures.

sentences.zh: 立措置京西營田司。

translations.literal: An office for arranging military colonies in Jingxi was established.
translations.idiomatic: An office to organize military colonies in Jingxi was established.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，詔宰臣復兼樞密使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yichou, an edict ordered the chief ministers again to hold concurrently the post of Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yichou day, an edict restored the chief ministers' concurrent post as military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金人攻隴城縣，官軍拒卻之，丙寅，詔帥臣、監司具部內知州治行臧否以聞。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Long Prefecture; the government troops repulsed them. On the day bingyin, an edict ordered military commissioners and circuit intendants to report on the good and bad conduct of prefects within their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens attacked Long county; government troops drove them back. On the bingyin day an edict required commanders and intendants to report on their prefects' conduct.

sentences.zh: 詔棄德順城，徙兵民于秦州以里屯住。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the abandonment of Deshun city and the relocation of troops and people to Qin Prefecture, quartered by li.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Deshun abandoned and its troops and people moved into Qinzhou, quartered by district.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以陳康伯兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Chen Kangbo was made Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Chen Kangbo was made military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 令江、淮宣撫司增招武勇效用軍。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai Pacification Office was ordered to increase recruitment of the Valiant and Effective Army.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai pacification office was ordered to recruit more men for the Valiant and Effective Army.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔侍從、台諫集議當今弊事，仍命盡率其屬，使極言無隱。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, an edict ordered attendants and remonstrating censors to assemble and discuss current abuses, and also ordered them to bring all their subordinates so that they might speak without reserve.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict called attendants and censors to debate current abuses and to bring their staffs so that nothing would be withheld.

sentences.zh: 辛未，劉珙、張說還自盱眙。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Liu Qi and Zhang Yue returned from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Liu Qi and Zhang Yue returned from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，蠲四川登極赦前帶白契稅錢。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the tax on white contracts levied before the accession amnesty in Sichuan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Sichuan's tax on unregistered white contracts, levied before the accession amnesty, was canceled.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔觀察使已上各舉所知三人，三省、樞密院詳議立格以聞。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict ordered observation commissioners and above each to recommend three men they knew; the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs were to deliberate and establish standards and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day an edict required observation commissioners and higher ranks each to nominate three men; the Three Departments and Military Affairs Bureau were to set standards and report.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷建康、鎮江營田官兵。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the military colonists at Jiankang and Zhenjiang were disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day military colonists at Jiankang and Zhenjiang were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廣西賊王宣破藤州，守臣廖顒棄城遁。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the Guangxi bandit Wang Xuan took Teng Prefecture; the defending official Liao Yong abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the Guangxi rebel Wang Xuan seized Tengzhou; defender Liao Yong fled the city.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路斷大辟四十一人。

translations.literal: That year, throughout the circuits forty-one persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year forty-one persons were executed empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年春正月壬辰朔，群臣朝於文德殿。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Longxing, on the first day of the month renchen, the hundred officials held court at the Hall of Civil Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Longxing 1, on the new year's day renchen, the officials held court at the Hall of Civil Virtue.

sentences.zh: 帝朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: The Emperor held court at the Palace of Virtuous Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor attended the retired emperor at the Palace of Virtuous Longevity.

sentences.zh: 立武臣薦舉格。

translations.literal: Standards for recommending military officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: Rules for recommending military officers were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 甲午，四川宣撫司奉詔班師。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Sichuan Pacification Office received an edict to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the Sichuan pacification office was ordered to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以史浩爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使，張浚進樞密使、都督江淮東西路軍馬。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Shi Hao was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of Military Affairs; Zhang Jun was advanced to Commissioner of Military Affairs and Commander-in-Chief of the Jiang-Huai East and West armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Shi Hao was made right personnel vice director, associate secretariat director, and military affairs commissioner; Zhang Jun was made military affairs commissioner and commander of Jiang-Huai East and West forces.

sentences.zh: 丙午，誅殿前司後軍謀變者。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, those who plotted mutiny in the rear army of the Palace Front Office were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day mutineers in the Palace Front Office rear army were executed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔禮部貢院試額增一百人。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict ordered the quota for candidates in the Ministry of Rites examination hall increased by one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day an edict raised the civil-service examination quota by one hundred.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔吳璘軍進退可從便宜。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict ordered that Wu Lin's army might advance or retreat as expedient.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day an edict gave Wu Lin's army discretion to advance or retreat.

sentences.zh: 璘已棄德順，道爲金人所邀，將士死者數萬計。

translations.literal: Lin had already abandoned Deshun; on the road he was intercepted by the Jurchens, and soldiers who died numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin had already abandoned Deshun; the Jurchens intercepted his retreat and tens of thousands of his men were killed.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌朔，用史浩策，以布衣李信爲兵部員外郎，齎蠟書間道往中原，招豪傑之據有州郡者，許以封王世襲。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day of the month renxu, following Shi Hao's plan, the commoner Li Xin was made Outer Office Secretary of the Ministry of War and sent by secret wax-sealed letter along a hidden route to the Central Plains to recruit bold men who held prefectures and districts, promising enfeoffment as kings with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new year's day renxu, on Shi Hao's plan the commoner Li Xin was made war ministry outer secretary and sent with a sealed letter by secret route into the north to recruit local strongmen holding territory, promising them princely titles heritable in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 安慶軍節度使士篯乞減奉賜之半，以助軍用。

translations.literal: Shi Qian, Military Commissioner of Anqing, requested to reduce his salary and gifts by half to aid military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Qian, Anqing military commissioner, asked to cut his stipend and gifts by half for the war effort.

sentences.zh: 自是，諸宗室有請，悉從之。

translations.literal: From this time, whenever members of the imperial clan made such requests, all were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter every imperial clansman who made the same request was granted it.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宰執陳康伯等乞再減奉，止存舊格之半，許之。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the chief ministers Chen Kangbo and others requested again to reduce their salaries, keeping only half the old standard; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Chief Ministers Chen Kangbo and others asked again to halve their salaries, keeping only half the old rate; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，振兩淮流民及山東歸正忠義軍。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, refugees of the two Huai regions and the loyal and righteous armies of Shandong who had returned to allegiance were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day refugees from both sides of the Huai and loyalists from Shandong who had returned to Song allegiance were given relief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，黃祖舜罷。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Huang Zuxun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Huang Zuxun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，逐秦檜黨人，仍禁輒至行在。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Qin Hui's faction was banished and forbidden to come to the mobile court without special permission.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Qin Hui's followers were expelled and forbidden to approach the court.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，金左副元帥紇石烈志寧以書取侵地。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day of the month renchen, the Jin Left Deputy Marshal Heshilie Zhining sent a letter demanding the return of invaded territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new year's day renchen, the Jin left deputy marshal Heshilie Zhining sent a letter demanding the return of seized lands.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以張燾爲參知政事，御史中丞辛次膺同知樞密院事，葉義問落端明殿學士、饒州居住。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Zhang Tao was made Vice Director; Censor-in-Chief Xin Ciying was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ye Yiwen was stripped of his Hanlin academician title and made to reside at Rao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Zhang Tao was made vice director; censor-in-chief Xin Ciying was made associate military affairs director; Ye Yiwen was stripped of his Hanlin rank and sent to live at Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔戶部置局，議節浮費。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to establish an office to discuss reducing wasteful expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day an edict ordered the Revenue Ministry to set up an office to curb wasteful spending.

sentences.zh: 己亥，楊存中等乞減半奉如宰執例，許之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Yang Cunzhong and others requested to halve their salaries as the chief ministers had done; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day Yang Cunzhong and others asked to halve their salaries like the chief ministers; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以龍大淵知閣門事，曾覿同知閣門事。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Long Dayuan was made Commissioner of the Gate Office; Zeng Di was made Associate Commissioner of the Gate Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Long Dayuan was made gate commissioner; Zeng Di was made associate gate commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，陳康伯上欽宗陵名曰永獻。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Chen Kangbo submitted the posthumous temple name of Emperor Qinzong as Yongxian.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Chen Kangbo proposed the temple name Yongxian for Emperor Qinzong.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔求遺逸。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict sought men of talent in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day an edict called for hidden talent.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔修《太上皇帝聖政》。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, an edict ordered the compilation of the Sagely Governance of the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict ordered compilation of the Retired Emperor's Sagely Governance.

sentences.zh: 罷龍大淵，別與差遣。

translations.literal: Long Dayuan was dismissed and given another appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Long Dayuan was dismissed and reassigned.

sentences.zh: 曾覿復帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Zeng Di again received charge of imperial equipage.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Di again received charge of imperial equipage.

sentences.zh: 召張浚。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張燾罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Zhang Tao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Zhang Tao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 立選人減舉主法。

translations.literal: The law reducing the number of examination sponsors for selectees was established.
translations.idiomatic: A law reducing sponsors required for examination candidates was enacted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復龍大淵知閤門事。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Long Dayuan was restored as Commissioner of the Gate Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Long Dayuan was restored as gate commissioner.

sentences.zh: 曾覿同閣門事，給事中、中書舍人留黃不行。

translations.literal: Zeng Di was made Associate Commissioner of the Gate Office; the Supervising Drafter and Secretariat Drafter Liu Huang did not carry out the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Di was made associate gate commissioner; supervising drafter Liu Huang refused to draft the appointment.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔飭郡縣吏。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, an edict admonished prefectural and county clerks.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict admonished local clerks.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以久雨，命有司振災傷，察刑禁。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, because of prolonged rain, the relevant offices were ordered to relieve disaster victims and review criminal punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, after prolonged rain, officials were ordered to aid disaster victims and review punishments.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，定選人改官歲額。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yichou, the annual quota for selectees changing office was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the yichou day, the annual quota for civil-service promotions was fixed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，張浚入見，議出師渡淮，三省、樞密院不預聞。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Zhang Jun entered for audience and discussed crossing the Huai in campaign; the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs were not consulted beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Zhang Jun was received in audience and urged a crossing of the Huai; the Three Departments and Military Affairs Bureau had not been told in advance.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜禮部進士木待問以下五百三十八人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Mu Daiwen and five hundred thirty-eight others below him in the Ministry of Rites graduates were given jinshi and other degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Mu Daiwen and 538 others were granted jinshi and lower degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，王之望罷。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Wang Zhiwang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Wang Zhiwang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔戶部、台諫議節浮費。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue and the remonstrating censors to discuss reducing wasteful expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day an edict charged the Revenue Ministry and remonstrating censors with curbing wasteful spending.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔以白金二十五萬兩給江、淮都督府軍費。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, an edict ordered two hundred fifty thousand taels of white silver given to the Jiang-Huai Commander-in-Chief's Office for military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day an edict allotted 250,000 taels of silver to the Jiang-Huai command for military expenses.

sentences.zh: 戊子，張浚命邵宏淵帥師次盱眙。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Zhang Jun ordered Shao Hongyuan to lead the army and encamp at Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Zhang Jun ordered Shao Hongyuan to take the army to Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，又命李顯忠帥師次定遠。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, he again ordered Li Xianzhong to lead the army and encamp at Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day he ordered Li Xianzhong to encamp at Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人拔環州，守臣強霓及其弟震死之。

translations.literal: That month the Jurchens took Huan Prefecture; the defending official Qiang Ni and his younger brother Zhen died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jurchens captured Huanzhou; defender Qiang Ni and his brother Zhen were killed.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，申嚴鋪翠銷金及神祠僭擬之禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renchen, prohibitions were strictly enforced against paving with kingfisher feathers, gilding, and unauthorized imitation at spirit shrines.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renchen day, strict bans were enforced on kingfisher inlay, gilding, and illicit shrine ornament.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，李顯忠復靈壁縣。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Li Xianzhong recovered Lingbi County.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Li Xianzhong recovered Lingbi.

sentences.zh: 邵宏淵次虹縣，金人拒之。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan encamped at Hong County; the Jurchens resisted him.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Hongyuan encamped at Hong county while the Jurchens held him off.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，顯忠東趨虹縣。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Xianzhong marched east toward Hong County.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Xianzhong marched east toward Hong county.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復虹縣，金知泗州蒲察徒穆及同知泗州大周仁降。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Hong County was recovered; Pucha Tumu, Jin prefect of Si, and Dazhou Ren, vice prefect of Si, surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Hong county was retaken; the Jin prefect of Sizhou Pucha Tumu and vice prefect Dazhou Ren surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命左右史日更立前殿。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Left and Right Recorders were ordered to take turns standing duty daily in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the left and right recorders were ordered to stand daily duty in rotation at the front hall.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，張浚渡江視師。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Zhang Jun crossed the river to oversee the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Zhang Jun crossed the Yangzi to take command in the field.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金右翼軍都統蕭琦降于李顯忠。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Xiao Qi, Right Wing Army Commander-in-Chief of the Jin, surrendered to Li Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the Jin right-wing commander Xiao Qi surrendered to Li Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，顯忠及宏淵敗金人於宿州。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Xianzhong and Hongyuan defeated the Jurchens at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Xianzhong and Hongyuan defeated the Jurchens at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙己，史浩罷。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Shi Hao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Shi Hao was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 追復司馬康右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Sima Kang was posthumously restored as Right Remonstrance Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Kang was posthumously restored as right remonstrance officer.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復宿州，戮金兵數千人。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Suzhou was recovered and several thousand Jin soldiers were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Suzhou was retaken and several thousand Jin troops were put to the sword.

sentences.zh: 建康前軍統領官王珙巷戰，死之。

translations.literal: Wang Gong, commanding officer of the forward army at Jiankang, fought in the lanes and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gong, forward-army commander at Jiankang, fought street by street and was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以辛次膺爲參知政事，翰林學士承旨洪遵同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Xin Ciying was made Vice Director; Hong Zun, Academician Expositor of the Hanlin Academy, was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Xin Ciying was made vice director and Hanlin expositor Hong Zun associate military affairs director.

sentences.zh: 督諸路開營田。

translations.literal: All circuits were ordered to open military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: All circuits were ordered to establish military colonies.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詣德壽宮賀天申節。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, he went to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity to congratulate on the Heavenly Application Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day he went to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity for the Heavenly Application Festival.

sentences.zh: 金紇石烈志甯自睢陽引兵至宿州，李顯忠擊卻之。

translations.literal: The Jin commander Heshilie Zhining led troops from Suiyang to Suzhou; Li Xianzhong repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin commander Heshilie Zhining marched from Suiyang to Suzhou; Li Xianzhong drove him back.

sentences.zh: 壬子，欽宗大祥，帝服衰服詣几筵，易祥服行祥祭禮。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, on the great mourning for Emperor Qinzong, the Emperor wore mourning garments and went to the spirit seat, then changed to auspicious garments and performed the auspicious mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, at the great mourning for Emperor Qinzong, the emperor wore mourning, attended the spirit seat, then changed to auspicious dress for the closing rites.

sentences.zh: 顯忠與金人戰於宿州，邵宏淵不援，顯忠失利。

translations.literal: Xianzhong fought the Jurchens at Suzhou; Shao Hongyuan did not reinforce him, and Xianzhong suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhong fought the Jurchens at Suzhou; Shao Hongyuan failed to reinforce him and Xianzhong was beaten.

sentences.zh: 是夜，建康中軍統制周巨集及邵巨集淵之子世雄、殿前司統制官左士淵逃歸。

translations.literal: That night, Zhou Ji, commander of the middle army at Jiankang, and Shao Ji, son of Hongyuan, Shijiong, and Zuo Shiyuan, commanding officer of the Palace Front Office, fled back.
translations.idiomatic: That night Jiankang middle-army commander Zhou Ji, Hongyuan's son Shijiong, and Palace Front commander Zuo Shiyuan fled back.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，進李顯忠開府儀同三司、淮南京畿京東河北招討使，邵宏淵檢校少保、甯遠軍節度使、招討副使。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Li Xianzhong was advanced to Grand Preceptor with the same ceremonial honors as the Three Excellencies and Pacification and Recruiting Commissioner of Huainan, the Capital District, Jingdong, and Hebei; Shao Hongyuan was made Junior Guardian by inspection, Military Commissioner of Ningyuan, and Deputy Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Li Xianzhong was made grand preceptor with Three Excellencies honors and pacification commissioner for Huainan, the capital region, Jingdong, and Hebei; Shao Hongyuan was made junior guardian by inspection, Ningyuan commissioner, and deputy pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金人攻宿州城，顯忠大敗之。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Suzhou city; Xianzhong inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens assaulted Suzhou, Xianzhong routed them.

sentences.zh: 殿前司統制官張訓通等七人、統領官十二人，以二將不葉而遁。

translations.literal: Zhang Xuntong and seven others, commanding officers of the Palace Front Office, and twelve unit commanders fled because the two generals would not cooperate.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front commanders Zhang Xuntong and seven others, with twelve unit leaders, fled because the two generals would not cooperate.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，李顯忠、邵宏淵軍大潰于符離。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the armies of Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan suffered a great rout at Fuli.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day the armies of Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan were routed at Fuli.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，下詔親征。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, an edict was issued for a personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict proclaimed the emperor's personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召汪澈。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Wang Che was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Wang Che was summoned.

sentences.zh: 以張浚兼都督荆、襄軍馬。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was made concurrently Commander-in-Chief of the Jing and Xiang armies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was also made commander of Jing and Xiang forces.

sentences.zh: 李顯忠、邵宏淵至濠州。

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan reached Hao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan reached Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 張浚以劉寶爲鎮江諸軍都統制。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun made Liu Bao Commander-in-Chief of all armies at Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun made Liu Bao commander-in-chief of all Zhenjiang forces.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以蒲察徒穆、大周仁、蕭琦並爲節度使，徒穆大同軍、周仁彰國軍、琦威塞軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Pucha Tumu, Dazhou Ren, and Xiao Qi were all made Military Commissioners—Tumu of Datong, Ren of Zhangguo, and Qi of Weisai.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day Pucha Tumu, Dazhou Ren, and Xiao Qi were all made military commissioners—of Datong, Zhangguo, and Weisai respectively.

sentences.zh: 遣御前忠勇軍赴都督府。

translations.literal: The Loyal and Valiant Army of the Inner Court was sent to the Commander-in-Chief's Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Court Loyal and Valiant Army was sent to headquarters.

sentences.zh: 是月，成都地震三。

translations.literal: That month Chengdu was shaken by three earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chengdu suffered three earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day of the month gengshen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon gengshen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 遣內侍趣上淮東將士功賞。

translations.literal: Inner attendants were sent to urge the granting of merit rewards to officers and soldiers on Huai East.
translations.idiomatic: Palace envoys were sent to hurry merit rewards to Huai East troops.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，汪澈罷。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Wang Che was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Wang Che was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 張浚乞致仕，且請通好，皆不許。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun requested retirement and also requested peace; both were refused.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun asked to retire and to open peace talks; both requests were denied.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以觀文殿大學士湯思退爲醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Tang Situi, Grand Academician of the Hall for Explicating Literature, was made Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey and Concurrent Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Tang Situi, Explicating Literature grand academician, was made Liquan Abbey commissioner and concurrent lecturer.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，召虞允文。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Yu Yunwen was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Yu Yunwen was summoned.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎周葵爲參知政事。

translations.literal: Zhou Kui, Vice Director of the Ministry of War, was made Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: War ministry vice director Zhou Kui was made vice director.

sentences.zh: 汪澈落資政殿學士、台州居住。

translations.literal: Wang Che was stripped of his Hanlin academician title and made to reside at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Che was stripped of his Hanlin rank and sent to live at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，張浚自盱眙還揚州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Zhang Jun returned from Xuyi to Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Zhang Jun withdrew from Xuyi to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，李顯忠罷軍職。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Li Xianzhong was dismissed from military office.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Li Xianzhong was removed from military command.

sentences.zh: 壬申，乙太傅、同安郡王楊存中爲御營使、節制殿前司軍馬。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Grand Preceptor and Prince of Tong'an, Yang Cunzhong, was made Commissioner of the Imperial Camp and Controller of Palace Front Office troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Grand Preceptor Yang Cunzhong, Prince of Tong'an, was made imperial camp commissioner and given control of Palace Front troops.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, an edict blaming himself was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day the emperor issued a self-reproach edict.

sentences.zh: 張浚降授特進，仍前樞密使、江淮東西路宣撫使，官屬各奪二官。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was demoted to Special Advance, but retained his former post as Commissioner of Military Affairs and Pacification Commissioner of Jiang-Huai East and West; his staff each had two ranks stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was demoted to special advance but kept his posts as military affairs commissioner and Jiang-Huai East-West pacification commissioner; each of his staff lost two ranks.

sentences.zh: 邵宏淵降武義大夫，職仍舊。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan was demoted to Grand Master of Martial Righteousness but kept his former duties.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Hongyuan was demoted to grand master of martial righteousness but kept his post.

sentences.zh: 詔楊存中先詣建康措置營砦，檢視沿江守備。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yang Cunzhong first to go to Jiankang to arrange camps and fortresses and inspect defenses along the river.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Yang Cunzhong first to Jiankang to build camps and inspect river defenses.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔展巡幸之期。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict extended the date of the imperial tour.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day an edict postponed the planned imperial tour.

sentences.zh: 辛次膺罷。

translations.literal: Xin Ciying was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Ciying was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，李顯忠責授清遠軍節度副使、筠州安置。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Li Xianzhong was demoted to Vice Military Commissioner of Qingyuan and ordered to reside at Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Li Xianzhong was demoted to Qingyuan vice commissioner and exiled to Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命浙西副都總管李寶兼御營統制官、措置浙西海道。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Li Bao, Deputy Commander-in-Chief of Zhexi, was made concurrently Imperial Camp Commander and Commissioner for Arranging the Zhexi Sea Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Zhexi deputy commander Li Bao was also made imperial camp commander and commissioner for the Zhexi sea route.

sentences.zh: 甲申，右諫議大夫王大寶入封，論移蹕。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Right Remonstrance Officer Wang Dabao entered with a sealed memorial discussing the move of the imperial residence.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Right Remonstrance Officer Wang Dabao submitted a sealed memorial on moving the court.

sentences.zh: 以敷文閣學士虞允文爲兵部尚書兼湖北、京西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen, Academician of the Hall for Spreading Culture, was made Minister of War and Commissioner for Proclamation of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen, Spreading Culture academician, was made war minister and Hubei-Jingxi proclamation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，放宮人三十人。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, thirty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day thirty palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 以蕭琦爲檢校少保、河北招撫使。

translations.literal: Xiao Qi was made Junior Guardian by inspection and Pacification Commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Qi was made junior guardian by inspection and Hebei pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅朔，以虞允文爲湖北、京西制置使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day of the month gengyin, Yu Yunwen was made Commissioner for Arrangement of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the new moon gengyin, Yu Yunwen was made Hubei-Jingxi arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以湯思退爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Tang Situi was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of Military Affairs.
