translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Tang Situi was made right personnel vice director, associate secretariat director, and military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 李顯忠再責授果州團練副使、潭州安置。

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong was again demoted to Vice Regimental Commander of Guo and ordered to reside at Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong was demoted again to Guo vice regimental commander and exiled to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔宿州棄軍將佐奪官、貶竄有差。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, an edict ordered the officers and men who had abandoned Suzhou stripped of office and exiled in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day an edict punished the officers who had abandoned Suzhou with dismissal and exile in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Great White star was visible by day and crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Venus was visible by day and crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 罷江、淮宣撫司便宜行事。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai Pacification Office's power to act as expedient was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai pacification office's discretionary powers were revoked.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以旱蝗、星變，詔侍從、台諫、兩省官條上時政闕失。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, because of drought, locusts, and strange stars, an edict ordered attendants, censors, and officials of the Two Departments to list current policy failings.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, after drought, locusts, and ominous stars, an edict called on attendants, censors, and Two Department officials to report policy failures.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔征李顯忠侵欺官錢金銀，免籍其家。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, an edict ordered the investigation of Li Xianzhong's embezzlement of official money, gold, and silver, but exempted his household from confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict ordered an inquiry into Li Xianzhong's embezzlement but spared his family from confiscation.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，裁減省、部、寺、監官吏。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the officials of the departments, ministries, directorates, and commissions were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day staffs of the central departments were cut.

sentences.zh: 戊午，給還岳飛田宅。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Yue Fei's fields and residences were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Yue Fei's lands and house were restored to his family.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，張浚復都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingyin, Zhang Jun was again made Commander-in-Chief of Jiang-Huai troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingyin day, Zhang Jun was again made Jiang-Huai commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以劉寶兼淮東招撫使。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Liu Bao was made concurrently Pacification Commissioner of Huai East.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Liu Bao was also made Huai East pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以飛蝗、風水爲災，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, because of locusts, wind, and flood as disasters, the Emperor left the hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, after locusts, wind, and flood, the emperor left the hall and cut his meals.

sentences.zh: 罷借諸路職田之令。

translations.literal: The order borrowing official fields from all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The order to borrow official fields from the circuits was rescinded.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，金紇石烈志寧又以書求海、泗、唐、鄧四州地及歲幣。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the Jin commander Heshilie Zhining again sent a letter demanding the four prefectures of Hai, Si, Tang, and Deng and the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Jin commander Heshilie Zhining again demanded the four prefectures of Hai, Si, Tang, and Deng plus annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復以龍大淵知閣門事，曾覿同知閣門事。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Long Dayuan was again made Commissioner of the Gate Office and Zeng Di Associate Commissioner of the Gate Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Long Dayuan was again gate commissioner and Zeng Di associate gate commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣淮西安撫司幹辦公事盧仲賢等齎書至金帥府，戒勿許四州，差減歲幣。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Lu Zhongxian and others of the Huai West Pacification Office were sent with a letter to the Jin headquarters, instructed not to concede the four prefectures and to reduce the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Lu Zhongxian of the Huai West pacification office was sent to Jin headquarters with orders not to yield the four prefectures and to cut the tribute.

sentences.zh: 仍命諸將毋遣兵人出境。

translations.literal: The generals were also ordered not to send troops across the border.
translations.idiomatic: Generals were also forbidden to send troops beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，楊存中罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiyou, Yang Cunzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiyou day, Yang Cunzhong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午朔，大臣奏金帥書言四事，帝曰：「四州地、歲幣可與，名分、歸正人不可從。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day of the month wuwu, the chief ministers memorialized the Jin commander's letter on four points. The Emperor said: 'The four prefectures and the annual tribute may be granted; titles and those who have returned to allegiance cannot be conceded.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the new moon wuwu, ministers reported the Jin commander's four demands. The emperor said, 'The four prefectures and tribute may be granted; titles and defectors may not.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the Emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day the emperor resumed normal meals in the hall.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣護聖軍戍江南。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Guarding the Sage Army was sent to garrison the south of the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the Guarding the Sage Army was posted south of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔慶上皇后教旨改稱聖旨。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, an edict ordered that the empress dowager's instructions be styled imperial instructions.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day an edict styled the empress dowager's orders as imperial instructions.

sentences.zh: 立賢妃夏氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: The Worthy Consort Xia was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Worthy Consort Xia was made empress.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，升洪州爲隆興府。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Hong Prefecture was promoted to Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Hongzhou was elevated to Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔：「江、淮軍馬調發應援，從都督府取旨，餘事悉以聞。

translations.literal: An edict said: 'When Jiang-Huai troops are transferred for reinforcement, orders shall be taken from the Commander-in-Chief's Office; all other matters shall be reported.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: 'Jiang-Huai troop movements for reinforcement require headquarters' approval; all else must be reported.

sentences.zh: 」十一月己丑，盧仲賢自宿州以金都元帥僕散忠義遺三省、樞密院書來。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jichou, Lu Zhongxian came from Suzhou with a letter from the Jin Commander-in-Chief Pusan Zhongyi to the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jichou day, Lu Zhongxian returned from Suzhou with a letter from Jin commander Pusan Zhongyi to the central ministries.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣王子望等爲金國通問使。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Wang Ziwang and others were sent as envoys to inquire of the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Wang Ziwang and others were sent as envoys to the Jin court.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔侍從、台諫於後省集議講和、遣使、禮數、土貢四事，仍各薦可備小使者。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict ordered attendants and censors to assemble at the Secretariat and Chancellery to discuss peace, sending envoys, ritual forms, and tribute—four matters—and each to recommend men fit to serve as minor envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day an edict called attendants and censors to the Secretariat to debate peace, envoys, ritual, and tribute, and to nominate junior envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙午，盧仲賢擅許四州，下大理寺，奪三官。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Lu Zhongxian had on his own authority conceded the four prefectures; he was sent to the Court of Judicial Review and stripped of three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Lu Zhongxian was found to have conceded the four prefectures on his own authority; he was tried and stripped of three ranks.

sentences.zh: 召張浚。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was recalled.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以胡昉、楊由義爲使金通問國信所審議官。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Hu Fang and Yang Youyi were made Reviewing Officers of the Office for Credentialed Envoys to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Hu Fang and Yang Youyi were made reviewing officers for Jin envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，陳康伯罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiwei, Chen Kangbo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiwei day, Chen Kangbo was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張浚入見。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Zhang Jun entered for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Zhang Jun was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以湯思退爲尚書左僕射，張浚爲右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Tang Situi was made Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Zhang Jun Right Vice Director, both Associate Directors of the Secretariat and Chancellery and Commissioners of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Tang Situi was made left personnel vice director and Zhang Jun right vice director, both associate secretariat directors and military affairs commissioners.

sentences.zh: 浚仍都督江、淮東西路軍馬。

translations.literal: Jun still commanded Jiang-Huai East and West troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun still commanded Jiang-Huai East and West forces.

sentences.zh: 壬午，西南方有白氣。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, a white vapor appeared in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day a white vapor appeared in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 是歲，以兩浙大水、旱蝗，江東大水，悉蠲其租。

translations.literal: That year, because of great floods and locusts in the two Zhe circuits and great floods in Jiang East, all rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods and locusts in Zhe and floods in Jiangdong brought remission of all rents.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛卯，詔增德壽宮車輦儀衛。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day xinmao, an edict increased the chariots, guards, and ceremonial escort of the Palace of Virtuous Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two, on the xinmao day, an edict enlarged the retired emperor's guard and ceremonial escort.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，御文德殿，冊皇后。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, he presided at the Hall of Civil Virtue and enfeoffed the empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day he presided at the Hall of Civil Virtue and invested the empress.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，修三省法。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the regulations of the Three Departments were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day the regulations governing the Three Departments were revised.

sentences.zh: 乙未，及皇后朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the empress also paid court at the Palace of Virtuous Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day the empress also attended the retired emperor at his palace.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命虞允文調兵討廣西諸盜。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Yu Yunwen was ordered to transfer troops to suppress the bandits of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Yu Yunwen was ordered to move troops against the Guangxi bandits.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷諸州招軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, recruitment of soldiers in all prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day recruitment in all prefectures was halted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，金僕散忠義復以書來。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the Jin commander Pusan Zhongyi again sent a letter.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Jin commander Pusan Zhongyi sent another letter.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，申嚴卿監、郎官更出迭入之制。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the system requiring directors and supervisors and court gentlemen to rotate in and out of office was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day rotation rules for directors, supervisors, and court gentlemen were strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 壬子，振歸正人。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, those who had returned to allegiance were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day defectors who had returned to Song allegiance were given relief.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, white vapor stretched across the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 是月，福建諸州地震。

translations.literal: That month, the prefectures of Fujian were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fujian prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，蠲秀州貧民逋租。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinwei, the arrears in rent of the poor of Xiu Prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinwei day, poor tenants' rent arrears in Xiu Prefecture were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬申，容州妖賊李雲作亂。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the demonic bandit Li Yun of Rong Prefecture rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day the sorcerer-rebel Li Yun of Rongzhou rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復王權武義大夫，命權廣西路都鈐轄，專一措置盜賊。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Wang Quan was restored to Grand Master of Martial Righteousness and ordered as Commander-in-Chief of Guangxi West to deal exclusively with bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Wang Quan was restored to grand master of martial righteousness and made Guangxi West commander-in-chief to suppress bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔飭將帥減文武官及百司吏郊賜之半。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, an edict admonished generals to cut by half the suburban gifts to civil and military officials and clerks of the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day an edict ordered generals to halve suburban gifts to officials and clerks.

sentences.zh: 罷兩浙、福建、江西、湖南、夔州路參議官。

translations.literal: The advisory posts in the circuits of the two Zhe, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Kuizhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Advisory posts in Zhe, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Kuizhou circuits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雨雹及雪。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, hail and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day hail and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 獲李雲，其党悉平。

translations.literal: Li Yun was captured and his party was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun was captured and his followers were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，胡昉自宿州還。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Hu Fang returned from Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Hu Fang returned from Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，金帥以昉等不許四郡，械系之，昉等不屈，金主命歸之。

translations.literal: Earlier, because the Jin commander would not grant the four prefectures, he had Hu Fang and the others shackled; they did not yield, and the Jin ruler ordered them returned.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Jin commander had shackled Hu Fang's party for refusing to yield the four prefectures; they held firm, and the Jin ruler sent them back.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，詔張浚視師於淮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day of the month bingxu, an edict ordered Zhang Jun to oversee the army on the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon bingxu, an edict ordered Zhang Jun to take the field on the Huai.

sentences.zh: 又詔王之望等以幣還。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Wang Ziwang and the others to return with the tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Wang Ziwang's mission to return with the tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔荆襄、川陝帥臣嚴邊備，毋先事妄舉。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict ordered the military commissioners of Jingxiang and Sichuan-Shaanxi to tighten border defenses and not act rashly before events.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day an edict ordered Jingxiang and Sichuan-Shaanxi commanders to strengthen defenses and not provoke incidents.

sentences.zh: 盧仲賢除名，械送郴州編管。

translations.literal: Lu Zhongxian's name was struck from the rolls; he was sent in fetters to Chen Prefecture for registered supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhongxian was struck from the rolls and sent in fetters to Chenzhou for supervised exile.

sentences.zh: 壬寅。

translations.literal: On the day renyin.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day.

sentences.zh: 詔知光州皇甫倜毋招納歸正人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huangfu Tong, prefect of Guang, not to recruit those who had returned to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade Guang prefect Huangfu Tong to recruit northern defectors.

sentences.zh: 丙午，王宣等降。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Wang Xuan and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Wang Xuan and others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 詔三衙戍兵歸司，建康、鎮江大軍更番歸砦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the garrison troops of the Three Guards to return to their offices; the great armies of Jiankang and Zhenjiang were to rotate in turn back to their camps.
translations.idiomatic: An edict returned Three Guards garrisons to their commands and rotated Jiankang and Zhenjiang main forces back to camp.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，芝生德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, auspicious fungus grew at the Palace of Virtuous Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day auspicious fungus appeared at the Palace of Virtuous Longevity.

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎錢端禮爲淮東宣諭使，吏部侍郎王之望爲淮西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Qian Duanli, Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Pacification Commissioner of Huai East; Wang Zhiwang, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Pacification Commissioner of Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue vice director Qian Duanli was made Huai East pacification commissioner; personnel vice director Wang Zhiwang was made Huai West pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔撫諭兩淮軍民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered reassurance of troops and people on both sides of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered reassurance of civilians and soldiers on both sides of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以廣西賊平，詔減高、藤、雷、容四州雜犯死罪囚，釋杖以下，蠲夏秋稅賦。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, because the Guangxi bandits were pacified, an edict reduced the death sentences of miscellaneous crimes in the four prefectures of Gao, Teng, Lei, and Rong, released those below the rod, and remitted summer and autumn taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, with Guangxi pacified, an edict commuted mixed capital crimes in Gao, Teng, Lei, and Rong, freed those below the rod, and remitted summer and autumn taxes.

sentences.zh: 以忠勇軍隸步軍司，神勁右軍隸鎮江都統司。

translations.literal: The Loyal and Valiant Army was placed under the Infantry Office; the Spirit-Stalwart Right Army was placed under the Zhenjiang Commander-in-Chief's Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Loyal and Valiant Army was assigned to the Infantry Office; the Spirit-Stalwart Right Army to the Zhenjiang command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以王彥爲建康諸軍都統制兼淮西招撫使。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Wang Yan was made Commander-in-Chief of all Jiankang armies and concurrently Pacification Commissioner of Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Wang Yan was made Jiankang commander-in-chief and Huai West pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，召張浚還朝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengshen, Zhang Jun was summoned back to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the gengshen day, Zhang Jun was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以李顯忠侵欺官錢給還諸軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the money Li Xianzhong had embezzled was returned to the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day funds Li Xianzhong had embezzled were returned to the armies.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以建康歸正人爲忠毅軍，鎮江爲忠順軍，命蕭琦、蕭鷓巴分領之。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the men from Jiankang who had returned to allegiance were made the Loyal and Resolute Army, and those from Zhenjiang the Loyal and Obedient Army; Xiao Qi and Xiao Zheba were ordered to command them respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Jiankang defectors became the Loyal and Resolute Army and Zhenjiang defectors the Loyal and Obedient Army, under Xiao Qi and Xiao Zheba.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷江、淮都督府。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Jiang-Huai Commander-in-Chief's Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day the Jiang-Huai headquarters was abolished.

sentences.zh: 高麗入貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，張浚罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Zhang Jun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day Zhang Jun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，言者論宰相、執政徇欺之弊，命書寘政事堂。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, remonstrators discussed the abuse of chief ministers and administrators who indulged in deception; an edict ordered this written and posted in the Hall of Government Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day critics attacked deceitful ministers; an edict ordered the charge posted in the Hall of Government Affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，復置環衛官。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renchen, the posts of the Imperial Guard were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renchen day, imperial guard posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔吳璘毋招納歸正人。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, an edict ordered Wu Lin not to recruit those who had returned to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day an edict forbade Wu Lin to recruit northern defectors.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔劉寶量度泗州輕重取捨事宜以聞。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict ordered Liu Bao to measure the weight of affairs at Sizhou and report what should be kept or abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day an edict charged Liu Bao to assess Sizhou's importance and report what to hold or abandon.

sentences.zh: 江西總管邵宏淵責授靖州團練副使、南安軍安置，仍征其盜用庫錢。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan, Commander-in-Chief of Jiangxi, was demoted to Vice Regimental Commander of Jing and ordered to reside at Nan'an; he was also ordered to repay treasury funds he had embezzled.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi commander Shao Hongyuan was demoted to Jing vice regimental commander, exiled to Nan'an, and ordered to repay embezzled funds.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，率群臣詣德壽宮賀天申節，始用樂。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, he led the hundred officials to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity to congratulate on the Heavenly Application Festival; music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day he led the officials to the retired emperor's palace for the Heavenly Application Festival; music was used for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丁未，蝗。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, locusts appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day locusts appeared.

sentences.zh: 詔內外贓私不法官吏，尚書省置籍檢勘。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that corrupt officials within and without the court be entered in a register at the Ministry of Personnel for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered corrupt officials inside and outside court registered at the Personnel Ministry for investigation.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷招神勁效用軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, recruitment of the Spirit-Stalwart Effective Army was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day recruitment of the Spirit-Stalwart Effective Army was halted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，鬻兩淮所招戶馬。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the household horses recruited on the two Huai were sold off.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day household horses recruited on the Huai were sold off.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day of the month jiayin, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以淫雨，詔州縣理滯囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, because of prolonged rain, an edict ordered prefectures and counties to clear delayed cases.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day prolonged rain brought an edict to clear backlogged cases.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Great White star was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命虞允文棄唐、鄧，允文不奉詔。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Yu Yunwen was ordered to abandon Tang and Deng; Yunwen did not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Yu Yunwen was ordered to abandon Tang and Deng; he refused.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，振江東、兩淮被水貧民。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the poor of Jiang East and the two Huai who had suffered from flood were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day flood victims in Jiangdong and on the Huai were given relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，召虞允文。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day yiyou, Yu Yunwen was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the yiyou day, Yu Yunwen was summoned.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書韓仲通爲湖北、京西制置使。

translations.literal: Han Zhongtong, Minister of Revenue, was made Commissioner for Arrangement of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue minister Han Zhongtong was made Hubei-Jingxi arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，洪遵罷。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Hong Zun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Hong Zun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以周葵兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Zhou Kui was made Acting Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Zhou Kui was made acting associate military affairs director.

sentences.zh: 遣主管馬軍司公事張守忠以兵詣淮西，措置邊備。

translations.literal: Zhang Shouzhong, Commissioner of Affairs of the Horse Army Office, was sent with troops to Huai West to arrange border defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Horse Army commissioner Zhang Shouzhong was sent with troops to Huai West to organize defenses.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the Great White star crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 詔內外文武官年七十不請致仕者，遇郊毋得蔭補。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that civil and military officials within and without the court who reached seventy and did not request retirement should not receive yin privilege at suburban sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred yin privilege at suburban rites for officials over seventy who would not retire.

sentences.zh: 乙巳。

translations.literal: On the day yisi.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day.

sentences.zh: 命海、泗州徹戍。

translations.literal: Hai and Si prefectures were ordered to withdraw their garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Hai and Sizhou were ordered to withdraw their garrisons.

sentences.zh: 丁未，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 戊申，蠲淮東內庫坊場錢一年。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the inner treasury's monopoly receipts in Huai East were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Huai East monopoly receipts owed to the inner treasury were forgiven for one year.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，洪遵落端明殿學士。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Hong Zun was stripped of his Hanlin academician title.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Hong Zun was stripped of his Hanlin rank.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以江東、浙西大水，詔侍從、台諫、卿監、郎官、館職陳闕失及當今急務。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, because of great floods in Jiang East and the two Zhe circuits, an edict ordered attendants, censors, directors, supervisors, court gentlemen, and academy fellows to memorialize failings and urgent matters of the day.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day floods in Jiangdong and Zhe brought an edict calling for memorials on failures and urgent affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷內侍押班梁珂爲在外宮觀。

translations.literal: That month, Inner Attendant Chief Escort Liang Ke was dismissed and given an outer palace sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: That month chief palace escort Liang Ke was dismissed to an outer sinecure.

sentences.zh: 移廣西提刑司于容州。

translations.literal: The Guangxi judicial intendant's office was moved to Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi judicial intendant's office was moved to Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiashen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiashen day.

sentences.zh: 罷內侍李珂賜諡。

translations.literal: Inner Attendant Li Ke was dismissed and given a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Inner attendant Li Ke was dismissed and given a posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔江東、浙西監司、守臣講明措置田事。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, an edict ordered the intendants and prefects of Jiang East and the two Zhe circuits to explain clearly measures for handling land affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day an edict required Jiangdong and Zhe intendants and prefects to set out land-policy measures.

sentences.zh: 乙未，交阯入貢。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Jiaozhi sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Jiaozhi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，嚴髒吏法。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the law against corrupt officials was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the law against corrupt officials was tightened.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以王之望爲參知政事，權刑部侍郎吳芾爲給事中兼淮西宣諭使。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Wang Zhiwang was made Vice Director; Wu Bi, Acting Vice Director of the Ministry of Punishments, was made Supervising Drafter and Pacification Commissioner of Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Wang Zhiwang was made vice director; acting punishments vice director Wu Bi was made supervising drafter and Huai West pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 金人犯邊。

translations.literal: The Jurchens invaded the border.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 以久雨，出內庫白金四十萬兩，糴米賑貧民。

translations.literal: Because of prolonged rain, four hundred thousand taels of white silver from the inner treasury were released to buy rice and relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged rain, 400,000 taels from the inner treasury were used to buy rice for the poor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，王彥帥師濟江，軍昭關。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Wang Yan led the army across the river and encamped at Zhao Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Wang Yan crossed the Yangzi and encamped at Zhao Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸卯。

translations.literal: On the day guimao.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day.

sentences.zh: 命湯思退都督江、淮東西路軍馬，辭不行。

translations.literal: Tang Situi was ordered Commander-in-Chief of Jiang-Huai East and West troops but declined to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situi was ordered to command Jiang-Huai forces but declined.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復命楊存中爲同都督，錢端禮、吳芾並爲都督府參贊軍事。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Yang Cunzhong was again made Associate Commander-in-Chief; Qian Duanli and Wu Bi were both made Staff Officers of the Commander-in-Chief's Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Yang Cunzhong was again associate commander; Qian Duanli and Wu Bi were made headquarters staff officers.

sentences.zh: 罷宣諭司。

translations.literal: The Pacification Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 仍易國書以付魏杞。

translations.literal: The state letter was also changed and given to Wei Qi.
translations.idiomatic: The state letter was revised and entrusted to Wei Qi.

sentences.zh: 少保、崇信軍節度使趙密落致仕，權領殿前司職事。

translations.literal: Zhao Mi, Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Chongxin, left retirement and was temporarily put in charge of Palace Front Office affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Junior Guardian Zhao Mi of Chongxin left retirement to act for the Palace Front Office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，魏杞至盱眙，金帥以國書未如式，弗受，欲得商、秦地及俘獲人，且邀歲幣三十萬，杞未得進。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiayin, Wei Qi reached Xuyi; the Jin commander would not receive it because the state letter was not in proper form, and demanded the prefectures of Shang and Qin and captives, and also pressed for three hundred thousand in annual tribute; Qi could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the jiayin day, Wei Qi reached Xuyi; the Jin commander rejected the letter as improperly formatted, demanded Shang and Qin prefectures and captives, and pressed for 300,000 in annual tribute; Qi could not proceed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賀允中罷爲資政殿大學士致仕。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, He Yunzhong was dismissed and made Grand Academician of the Hall for Explicating Literature with permission to retire.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day He Yunzhong retired as Explicating Literature grand academician.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以周葵兼權知樞密院事，王之望兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Zhou Kui was made Acting Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Wang Zhiwang Acting Associate Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Zhou Kui was acting associate military affairs director and Wang Zhiwang acting associate director.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔輔臣夕對便殿。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, an edict ordered the chief ministers to attend evening audiences in the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day an edict required chief ministers at evening audiences in the side hall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大風。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day a fierce wind blew.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蠲京西、湖北運糧所經州縣秋稅之半。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, half the autumn tax of the prefectures and counties along the grain transport route in Jingxi and Hubei was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day half the autumn tax was remitted in Jingxi and Hubei transport counties.

sentences.zh: 以靖海軍節度使李寶爲沿海駐紮御前水軍都統制。

translations.literal: Li Bao, Military Commissioner of the Pacifying the Sea Army, was made Commander-in-Chief of the Coastal Garrisoned Imperial Front Water Army.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying the Sea commissioner Li Bao was made coastal garrison water-army commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金人分道渡淮，劉寶棄楚州遁。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the Jurchens crossed the Huai in separate columns; Liu Bao abandoned Chu Prefecture and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day the Jurchens crossed the Huai in several columns; Liu Bao abandoned Chuzhou and fled.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，知楚州魏勝與金人戰，死之，州遂陷，濠州亦陷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yiyou, Wei Sheng, prefect of Chu, fought the Jurchens and died; the prefecture then fell, and Hao Prefecture also fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the yiyou day, Chuzhou prefect Wei Sheng fought the Jurchens and was killed; the city fell, and Haozhou fell as well.

sentences.zh: 王彥棄昭關遁，滁州又陷，丙戌，詔諭沿邊將士。

translations.literal: Wang Yan abandoned Zhao Pass and fled; Chu Prefecture also fell. On the day bingxu, an edict urged the border generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan abandoned Zhao Pass and fled; Chuzhou also fell. On the bingxu day an edict rallied the border forces.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔魏祀等以所齎禮幣犒軍。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict ordered Wei Qi and the others to use the tribute goods they carried to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day an edict ordered Wei Qi's party to use their tribute goods to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 杞弗從，命留鎮江侯旨。

translations.literal: Qi would not obey and was ordered to remain at Zhenjiang awaiting instructions.
translations.idiomatic: Qi refused and was ordered to wait at Zhenjiang for instructions.

sentences.zh: 復命王之望督視江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang was again ordered to supervise Jiang-Huai troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang was again ordered to supervise Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以金人侵擾，詔郊杞改用明年。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, because of Jurchen incursions, the suburban sacrifice was moved to the following year.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Jurchen raids postponed the suburban sacrifice to the following year.

sentences.zh: 又詔諭歸正官民軍士。

translations.literal: An edict also reassured officials, people, and soldiers who had returned to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also reassured defectors, civilians, and soldiers who had returned to Song allegiance.

sentences.zh: 命王之望同都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang was ordered concurrently Commander-in-Chief of Jiang-Huai troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang was also made Jiang-Huai commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 湯思退罷都督。

translations.literal: Tang Situi was dismissed as commander.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situi was removed as commander.

sentences.zh: 召陳康伯。

translations.literal: Chen Kangbo was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kangbo was summoned.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王之望罷同都督。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Wang Zhiwang was dismissed as associate commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Wang Zhiwang was removed as associate commander.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命楊存中都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Yang Cunzhong was ordered Commander-in-Chief of Jiang-Huai troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Yang Cunzhong was made Jiang-Huai commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，湯思退罷，尋以尹穡、晁公武論之，落觀文殿大學士、永州居住，未至而卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Tang Situi was dismissed; soon Yin Ji and Chao Gongwu attacked him, and he was stripped of his grand academician title and made to reside at Yong Prefecture; he died before he arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Tang Situi was dismissed; Yin Ji and Chao Gongwu soon denounced him, and he was stripped of his grand academician rank and exiled to Yongzhou, but died on the way.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以黃榜禁太學生伏闕。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, a yellow placard forbade Imperial University students to lie prostrate at the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day a yellow placard forbade university students to lie prostrate at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 是日，太學生張觀等七十二人上書，請斬湯思退、王之望、尹穡，竄其党洪適、晁公武而用陳康伯、胡銓等，以濟大計。

translations.literal: That day, seventy-two Imperial University students including Zhang Guan submitted a memorial requesting the execution of Tang Situi, Wang Zhiwang, and Yin Ji, the exile of their faction Hong Shi and Chao Gongwu, and the employment of Chen Kangbo, Hu Quan, and others to carry out the great plan.
translations.idiomatic: That day seventy-two university students led by Zhang Guan memorialized for the execution of Tang Situi, Wang Zhiwang, and Yin Ji, the exile of Hong Shi and Chao Gongwu, and the appointment of Chen Kangbo, Hu Quan, and others to save the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣國信所大通事王抃持周葵書如金帥府，請正皇帝號，爲叔侄之國；

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Wang Bian, Senior Communicator of the Office for Credentialed Envoys, was sent with Zhou Kui's letter to the Jin headquarters to request correction of the imperial title and a state of uncle and nephew;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Wang Bian, senior communicator of the credentialed envoys office, was sent with Zhou Kui's letter to Jin headquarters to fix the imperial title and establish an uncle-nephew relationship;

sentences.zh: 易歲貢爲歲幣，減十萬；

translations.literal: to change annual tribute to annual payments and reduce them by one hundred thousand;
translations.idiomatic: to rename annual tribute annual payments and cut them by 100,000;

sentences.zh: 割商、秦地；

translations.literal: to cede the prefectures of Shang and Qin;
translations.idiomatic: to cede Shang and Qin prefectures;

sentences.zh: 歸被俘人，惟叛亡者不與；

translations.literal: to return captives, except those who had rebelled and fled;
translations.idiomatic: to return captives except rebels and fugitives;

sentences.zh: 誓目大略與紹興同。

translations.literal: the oath in outline was the same as under Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: the oath in outline matched the Shaoxing agreement.

sentences.zh: 以金人犯淮南，詔避殿減膳。

translations.literal: Because the Jurchens invaded Huainan, an edict ordered leaving the hall and reducing meals.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Jurchens invaded Huainan, the emperor left the hall and cut his meals.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔擇日視師。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered a day chosen for overseeing the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day an edict fixed a day to take the field.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以少保、觀文殿大學士陳康伯爲尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Chen Kangbo, Junior Guardian and Grand Academician of the Hall for Explicating Literature, was made Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day Junior Guardian Chen Kangbo, Explicating Literature grand academician, was made left personnel vice director, associate secretariat director, and military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣兵部侍郎胡銓、右諫議大夫尹穡分詣兩浙措置海道。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Hu Quan, Vice Director of the Ministry of War, and Yin Ji, Right Remonstrance Officer, were sent separately to the two Zhe circuits to arrange the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day war vice director Hu Quan and right remonstrator Yin Ji were sent to the two Zhe circuits to organize the sea route.

sentences.zh: 贈魏勝甯國軍節度使，諡忠壯。

translations.literal: Wei Sheng was posthumously made Military Commissioner of Ningguo; his posthumous title was Loyal and Bold.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Sheng was posthumously made Ningguo military commissioner with the posthumous name Loyal and Bold.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，兵部尚書錢端禮賜出身，簽書樞密院事兼提領德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Qian Duanli, Minister of War, was granted examination credentials and made Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Chief Administrator of the Palace of Virtuous Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day war minister Qian Duanli was granted examination credentials and made signing military affairs secretary and chief administrator of the retired emperor's palace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔侍從、兩省官日一至都堂議事，有關台諫者亦聽會議。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict ordered attendants and officials of the Two Departments to go daily to the chief ministers' hall to discuss affairs; censors concerned were also permitted to attend.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day an edict required attendants and Two Department officials to meet daily at headquarters; relevant censors might attend.

sentences.zh: 以顯謨閣學士虞允文同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen, Academician of the Hall for Illustrious Counsel, was made Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Illustrious Counsel academician Yu Yunwen was made signing military affairs secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣王之望勞師江上。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Wang Zhiwang was sent to reward the troops on the river.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Wang Zhiwang was sent to reward troops on the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，金人犯六合縣，步軍司統制崔皋擊卻之。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Jurchens attacked Liuhe County; Cui Gao, commanding officer of the Infantry Office, repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the Jurchens attacked Liuhe; Infantry Office commander Cui Gao drove them back.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以錢端禮兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Qian Duanli was made Acting Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Qian Duanli was made acting vice director.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以顯謨閣直學士沈介爲沿江制置使。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Shen Jie, Academician of the Hall for Illustrious Counsel, was made Commissioner for Arrangement Along the River.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Illustrious Counsel academician Shen Jie was made river arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命沿江諸州調保甲分守渡口。

translations.literal: The prefectures along the river were ordered to mobilize militia to guard the crossings in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: River prefectures were ordered to rotate militia to guard the crossings.

sentences.zh: 己酉，劉寶落節鉞，爲武泰軍承宣使，王彥落龍神衛四廂都指揮使。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Liu Bao was stripped of his command seal and made Commissioner of the Wutai Army; Wang Yan was stripped of his post as Commander of the Four Wings of the Dragon Spirit Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Liu Bao lost his command seal and became Wutai commissioner; Wang Yan was removed as commander of the Dragon Spirit Guard's four wings.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅，陳康伯入見，詔康伯間日一朝，肩輿至殿門，給扶升殿。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiayin, Chen Kangbo entered for audience; an edict ordered Kangbo to attend court every other day, carried in a shoulder carriage to the hall gate, with supports given to help him ascend the hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the jiayin day, Chen Kangbo was received in audience; an edict allowed him to attend every other day by sedan to the hall gate, with aides to help him mount the steps.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，周葵罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Zhou Kui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Zhou Kui was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 王抃見金二帥，皆得其報書以歸。

translations.literal: Wang Bian saw the two Jin commanders and returned with their reply letters.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bian met both Jin commanders and returned with their replies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，蕭琦卒。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Xiao Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Xiao Qi died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌。

translations.literal: On the day renxu.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day.

sentences.zh: 詔罷胡銓、尹穡。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed Hu Quan and Yin Ji.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dismissed Hu Quan and Yin Ji.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，召韓仲通。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Han Zhongtong was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Han Zhongtong was summoned.

sentences.zh: 以沈介爲兵部尚書、湖北京西制置使。

translations.literal: Shen Jie was made Minister of War and Commissioner for Arrangement of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Jie was made war minister and Hubei-Jingxi arrangement commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以金人且退，詔督府擇利擊之，王之望執不可。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, because the Jurchens were about to withdraw, an edict ordered the headquarters to strike when advantage offered; Wang Zhiwang insisted it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, with the Jurchens preparing to withdraw, an edict ordered headquarters to strike when advantage offered; Wang Zhiwang refused.

sentences.zh: 乙亥。

translations.literal: On the day yihai.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day.

sentences.zh: 之望罷。

translations.literal: Zhiwang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以王抃爲奉使金國通問國信所參議官，持陳康伯報書以行。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Wang Bian was made Reviewing Officer of the Office for Credentialed Envoys to the Jin and sent with Chen Kangbo's reply letter.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Wang Bian was made Jin credentialed-envoy reviewing officer and sent with Chen Kangbo's reply.

sentences.zh: 丁丑。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day.

sentences.zh: 金遣張恭愈來迓使者。

translations.literal: The Jin sent Zhang Gongyu to welcome the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin sent Zhang Gongyu to welcome the envoy.

sentences.zh: 詔台諫、侍從、兩省官舉楚、廬、滁、濠四州守臣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered censors, attendants, and officials of the Two Departments to recommend prefects for the four prefectures of Chu, Lu, Chu, and Hao.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called on censors, attendants, and Two Department officials to nominate prefects for Chu, Lu, Chu, and Hao.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，罷陝西路轉運司。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiashen, the Shaanxi Circuit Transport Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jiashen day, the Shaanxi transport office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，魏杞始渡淮。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Wei Qi first crossed the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Wei Qi first crossed the Huai.

sentences.zh: 詔郊祀大禮遵至道典故，改用來年正月一日上辛。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the great suburban sacrifice to follow the precedents of the Zhidao era and moved it to the first upper-xin day of the first month of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: An edict moved the great suburban sacrifice to the first upper-xin day of the following year on Zhidao precedents.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以錢端禮爲參知政事兼知樞密院事，虞允文同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，禮部尚書王剛中簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Qian Duanli was made Vice Director and Commissioner of Military Affairs; Yu Yunwen was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Director; Wang Gangzhong, Minister of Rites, was made Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Qian Duanli was made vice director and military affairs commissioner; Yu Yunwen was associate director and acting vice director; rites minister Wang Gangzhong was signing secretary.

sentences.zh: 丙申，制曰：「比遣王抃，遠抵潁濱，得其要約。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, an imperial commission said: 'Recently Wang Bian was sent far to the banks of the Ying and obtained their essential terms.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day an imperial commission read: 'Wang Bian has just reached the Ying and secured their essential terms.

sentences.zh: 尋澶淵盟誓之信，仿大遼書題之儀，正皇帝之稱，爲叔侄之國，歲幣減十萬之數，地界如紹興之時。

translations.literal: Following the pledged faith of the Chanyuan alliance and imitating the formulary of the Great Liao, the imperial title is corrected, the state is one of uncle and nephew, the annual payment is reduced by one hundred thousand, and the territorial boundary is as under Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: Following Chanyuan's pledge and Liao formulary, the imperial title is corrected, the relationship is uncle and nephew, annual payments fall by 100,000, and borders revert to the Shaoxing line.

sentences.zh: 憐彼此之無辜，約叛亡之不遣，可使歸正之士咸起甯居之心。

translations.literal: Pitying the innocence on both sides, agreeing that rebels and fugitives shall not be sent back, those who have returned to allegiance may all rise with hearts at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Pitying the innocent on both sides and agreeing not to return rebels and fugitives, defectors may live in peace.

sentences.zh: 重念數州之民，罹此一時之難，老稚有蕩析之災，丁壯有系累之苦，宜推蕩滌之宥，少慰凋殘之情。

translations.literal: Thinking again of the people of several prefectures who have suffered this moment's hardship—the old and young disaster of scattering, the strong adult's pain of bonds—there should be extended the grace of sweeping clean, to comfort a little the feelings of the devastated.
translations.idiomatic: Remembering the people of the border prefectures—the old and young scattered, the adults in chains—sweeping amnesty should comfort the ruined.

sentences.zh: 應沿邊被兵州軍，除逃遁官吏不赦外，雜犯死罪情輕者減一等，餘並放遣。

translations.literal: In the prefectures and armies along the border that suffered military action, except fleeing officials who are not pardoned, miscellaneous capital crimes where the circumstances are light are reduced one degree, and the rest are all released.
translations.idiomatic: In border prefectures hit by war, except fleeing officials, light capital crimes are reduced one degree and the rest are released.

sentences.zh: 」遣洪適等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Hong Shi and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Shi and others were sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 詔吳挺市馬赴行在。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wu Ting to purchase horses and send them to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wu Ting to buy horses for the court.

sentences.zh: 己亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，罷三衙、江上、荆襄諸軍招軍。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, recruitment by the Three Guards and the armies on the river, Jingxiang, and elsewhere was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day recruitment by the Three Guards and river and Jingxiang armies was halted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣沿海水軍還屯。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the coastal water army was sent back to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the coastal water army returned to garrison.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, court was held at the Jingling Shrine of Offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day the emperor attended the Jingling Shrine of Offerings.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, court was held to offer sacrifice at the Great Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day the emperor offered sacrifice at the Great Temple.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiayin, the Great White star was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiayin day, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 己未，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the Emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day the emperor resumed normal meals in the hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以虞允文爲參知政事兼同知樞密院事，王剛中同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Yu Yunwen was made Vice Director and Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wang Gangzhong was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Yu Yunwen was made vice director and associate military affairs director; Wang Gangzhong was made associate director.

sentences.zh: 命淮西、湖北、荆襄帥臣措置屯田，復置榷場。

translations.literal: The military commissioners of Huai West, Hubei, and Jingxiang were ordered to arrange military colonies; the monopoly markets were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Huai West, Hubei, and Jingxiang commanders were ordered to organize military colonies and restore monopoly markets.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，黃祖舜薨。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Huang Zuxun died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Huang Zuxun died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, white vapor stretched across the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 己巳，罷諸軍額外制領將佐。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the extra commanding officers and assistants of the various armies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day extra army commanders and assistants were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Great White star crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 是春，湖南盜起，入廣東焚掠州縣，官軍討平之。

translations.literal: That spring, bandits rose in Hunan, entered Guangdong, and burned and plundered prefectures and counties; government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Hunan bandits crossed into Guangdong, burning and looting; government troops suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，金報問使完顏仲等入見。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengzi, the Jin envoys Wanyan Zhong and others entered for audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the gengzi day, Jin envoys led by Wanyan Zhong were received in audience.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，吳璘入見。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Wu Lin entered for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Wu Lin was received in audience.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，以璘爲太傅，封新安郡王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengxu, Lin was made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the gengxu day, Wu Lin was made grand preceptor and enfeoffed Prince of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔有司治皇后家廟。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict ordered the relevant offices to build the empress's family temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day an edict ordered the empress's family temple built.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔監司、帥守講究弊事以聞。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, an edict ordered circuit intendants and military commissioners to investigate abuses and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day an edict required intendants and commanders to investigate abuses and report.

sentences.zh: 合廣南東、西路監事爲一司。

translations.literal: The supervisory posts of Guangnan East and West circuits were combined into one office.
translations.idiomatic: Guangnan East and West supervisory posts were merged into one office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔總領、帥、漕臣、諸軍都統制並兼提領措置屯田，沿邊守臣兼管屯田事。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, an edict ordered chief administrators, commanders, transport commissioners, and army commanders-in-chief all concurrently to oversee military colonies, and border prefects also to manage colony affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day an edict made chief administrators, commanders, transport commissioners, and army commanders-in-chief oversee military colonies, with border prefects sharing the duty.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔吳璘措置馬綱、水路。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict ordered Wu Lin to arrange horse transport and the water route.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day an edict charged Wu Lin with horse transport and the water route.

sentences.zh: 壬申，蠲四川州縣虛額錢。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the fictitious quota payments of Sichuan prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Sichuan's fictitious quota payments were canceled.

sentences.zh: 吳璘改判興元府。

translations.literal: Wu Lin was transferred to serve as prefect of Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin was transferred to Xingyuan prefect.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔未銓試人毋得堂除。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict ordered that persons who had not passed the examination might not receive hall appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day an edict barred hall appointment for those who had not passed the examination.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣李若川等使金賀上尊號。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Li Ruochuan and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the bestowal of an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day Li Ruochuan and others were sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's new honorific.

sentences.zh: 增置諸路鈐轄、都監。

translations.literal: Additional commanders and surveillance commissioners were established in the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Additional circuit commanders and surveillance commissioners were established.

sentences.zh: 郴州盜李金等復作亂，遣兵討捕之。

translations.literal: The bandit Li Jin and others of Chen Prefecture again rose in rebellion; troops were sent to pursue and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Chenzhou rebel Li Jin rose again; troops were sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，王剛中薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guiwei, Wang Gangzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guiwei day, Wang Gangzhong died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔恭王府直講王淮傾邪不正，有違禮經，可與外任。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, an edict said the Lecturer Wang Huai of the Prince of Gong's mansion was perverse and improper and violated the classics; he might be given an outer post.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day an edict said Gong Prince mansion lecturer Wang Huai was corrupt and unorthodox and should be given an outer post.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以翰林學士洪適簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Hong Shi, Academician of the Hanlin Academy, was made Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Hanlin academician Hong Shi was made signing military affairs secretary.

sentences.zh: 戊子，步軍司統制官崔皋坐奏功冒濫，奪所遷觀察使，止進橫行三官，令本軍自效。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Cui Gao, commanding officer of the Infantry Office, was punished for falsely reporting merit; he was stripped of the observation commissioner rank he had received and advanced only three ranks in the lateral series, and ordered to prove himself in his own army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Infantry commander Cui Gao was punished for false merit claims; he lost his observation commissioner rank, gained only three lateral ranks, and was ordered to redeem himself in his own unit.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以武經郎令德爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Ling De, Martial Classics Officer, was made Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Martial Classics officer Ling De was made Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以淮南轉運判官姚岳言境內飛蝗自死，奪一官罷之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Yao Yue, transport judge of Huainan, reported that flying locusts in his jurisdiction had died of themselves; one rank was stripped and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Huainan transport judge Yao Yue reported locusts had died on their own in his jurisdiction; he lost one rank and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以兩淮守令勞徠安集無效，下詔戒飭之，仍以詔置守令治所。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, because the prefects and magistrates of the two Huai had been ineffective in comforting and settling the people, an edict admonished them and also ordered placards posted at prefectural and magisterial seats.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day an edict admonished Huai prefects and magistrates for failing to comfort the people and ordered warning placards posted at their offices.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，蠲廣東殘破郡縣稅賦。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the taxes of the ravaged prefectures and counties of Guangdong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day taxes were remitted in ravaged Guangdong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，罷湖北、京西制置司。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Hubei and Jingxi Arrangement Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the Hubei-Jingxi arrangement office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，詔知州年七十以上者與宮觀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinhai, an edict ordered that prefects seventy years of age and above be given palace sinecures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the xinhai day, an edict gave palace sinecures to prefects aged seventy and above.

sentences.zh: 癸丑。

translations.literal: On the day guichou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day.

sentences.zh: 輔臣晚對選德殿，御坐後有大屏，記注諸道監司、郡守姓名，因令都堂視此書之。

translations.literal: The chief ministers held evening audience at the Hall of Selecting Virtue; behind the imperial seat was a large screen recording the names of circuit intendants and prefects of the various routes; the emperor therefore ordered the chief ministers' hall to inscribe this book.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers held evening audience at the Hall of Selecting Virtue; behind the throne a screen listed circuit intendants and prefects, and the emperor ordered the list copied at headquarters.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，借職田租二年，以裨經費。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, official field rents were borrowed for two years to supplement expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day official field rents were borrowed for two years to meet expenses.

sentences.zh: 己未，鑄當二錢。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, coins worth two were cast.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day two-cash coins were cast.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蠲關外四州民今年租稅及湖南賊蹂郡縣夏稅。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, this year's rent and tax of the people of the four prefectures outside the pass and the summer tax of Hunan counties ravaged by bandits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day this year's taxes were remitted in the four prefectures beyond the pass and summer taxes in Hunan counties ravaged by bandits.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，以永豐圩田賜建康都統司。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jimao, the polder fields of Yongfeng were bestowed on the Jiankang Commander-in-Chief's Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jimao day, Yongfeng polder fields were granted to the Jiankang command.

sentences.zh: 癸未，獲李金。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Li Jin was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Li Jin was captured.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔立子愭爲皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, an edict established the son Qi as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day an edict made the son Qi crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，虞允文罷。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Yu Yunwen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Yu Yunwen was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以洪適爲參知政事兼權知樞密院事，吏部侍郎葉顒簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Hong Shi was made Vice Director and Acting Commissioner of Military Affairs; Ye Yong, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day Hong Shi was made vice director and acting military affairs commissioner; personnel vice director Ye Yong was made signing secretary and acting vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立知州軍、諸路總管鈐轄都監辭見法。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the law for farewell audiences of prefects, army commissioners, circuit commanders, and surveillance commissioners was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day farewell-audience rules were set for prefects, army commissioners, and circuit commanders.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，錢端禮以避東宮親嫌，罷爲資政殿大學士、提舉萬壽觀。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Qian Duanli, because of avoidance of close kinship with the Eastern Palace, was dismissed and made Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and Commissioner of the Longevity Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day Qian Duanli left office to avoid kinship with the crown prince and became Assisting Governance grand academician and Longevity Abbey commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，吏部侍郎章服以論虞允文阿附罷，謫居汀州。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Zhang Fu, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was dismissed for attacking Yu Yunwen as a flatterer and was banished to Ting Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day personnel vice director Zhang Fu was dismissed for denouncing Yu Yunwen as a flatterer and exiled to Tingzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，立廣國夫人錢氏爲皇太子妃。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yimao, Lady Qian of the Broad State was established as crown princess.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the yimao day, Lady Qian of Broad State was made crown princess.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，申嚴百司官出入局之制。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the system for officials of the hundred offices entering and leaving the bureau was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day rules on officials entering and leaving the central bureaus were tightened.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，升鼎州爲常德府。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Ding Prefecture was promoted to Changde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Dingzhou was elevated to Changde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以端明殿學士汪澈知樞密院事，洪適兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Wang Che, Hanlin Academician, was made Commissioner of Military Affairs; Hong Shi was made Associate Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Hanlin academician Wang Che was made military affairs commissioner and Hong Shi associate director.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，置沿淮諸州都巡檢。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, chief inspectors were established for the prefectures along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day chief inspectors were established for Huai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，遣方滋等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jimao, Fang Zi and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the jimao day, Fang Zi and others were sent to the Jin court for New Year greetings.

sentences.zh: 戊子，增頭子錢。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the surcharge on cash was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day the cash surcharge was raised.

sentences.zh: 歸正人右通直郎劉蘊古坐以軍器法式送北境，伏誅。

translations.literal: Liu Yungu, Right Vice Director of Communications for those who had returned to allegiance, was executed for sending the forms of military weapons to the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yungu, a returned-allegiance official, was executed for sending arms regulations to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，御大慶殿，冊皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the Emperor presided at the Hall of Great Celebration and enfeoffed the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day the emperor invested the crown prince at the Hall of Great Celebration.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詣德壽宮稱謝。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, he went to the Palace of Virtuous Longevity to offer thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day he went to the retired emperor's palace to offer thanks.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔侍從各舉所知宗室一二人。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, an edict ordered each attendant to recommend one or two members of the imperial clan he knew.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day an edict required each attendant to nominate one or two imperial clansmen.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，金遣高衎等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the Jin sent Gao Yan and others to congratulate the Festival of Accumulated Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the Jin sent Gao Yan and others to congratulate the Festival of Accumulated Celebration.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，淮北紅巾賊逾淮劫掠，立賞討捕之，已而知楚州胡明遣巡尉擊殺其首蕭榮。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, red-turban bandits north of the Huai crossed the river to plunder; a reward was posted for their capture; it was then learned that Hu Ming of Chu Prefecture had patrol officers kill their leader Xiao Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day red-turban bandits from north of the Huai raided south; a bounty was posted; later Chuzhou's Hu Ming reported his patrol had killed their leader Xiao Rong.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，招收兩淮流散忠義人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinhai, loyal men scattered on the two Huai were recruited.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinhai day, loyalists scattered on the Huai were recruited.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, white vapor stretched across the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣龍大淵撫諭兩淮，措置屯田，督捕盜賊。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Long Dayuan was sent to reassure the two Huai, arrange military colonies, and supervise the capture of bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Long Dayuan was sent to reassure the Huai, organize colonies, and hunt bandits.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，以洪适爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使，汪澈爲樞密使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuyin, Hong Shi was made Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of Military Affairs; Wang Che was made Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuyin day, Hong Shi was made right personnel vice director, associate secretariat director, and military affairs commissioner; Wang Che was military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命廣東提刑司招安李金餘黨。

translations.literal: The Guangdong judicial intendant's office was ordered to offer amnesty to the remnant party of Li Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong judicial intendant was ordered to offer amnesty to Li Jin's remnants.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣王曮等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Wang Yan and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Wang Yan and others were sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 康寅，以葉顒爲參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Ye Yong was made Vice Director and Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Ye Yong was made vice director and associate military affairs director.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔侍從、臺諫、兩省舉堪監司、郡守者各一人，三衙、知閣舉材武可守邊者一人。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, an edict ordered attendants, censors, and officials of the Two Departments each to recommend one man fit for circuit or prefectural office; the Three Guards and gate commissioners each to recommend one man of martial talent fit to guard the border.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day an edict called for one circuit or prefect nominee each from attendants, censors, and Two Department officials, and one border-worthy martial nominee from the Three Guards and gate commissioners.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷兩淮諸州權攝官。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, acting officials in the prefectures of the two Huai were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day acting officials in Huai prefectures were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金遣烏古論忠弼等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Jin sent Wugulun Zhongbi and others to congratulate the New Year of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day the Jin sent Wugulun Zhongbi and others to greet the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 癸卯。

translations.literal: On the day guimao.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密院文書依三省式，經中書門下畫黃書讀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Military Affairs documents to follow the Three Departments format, passing through the Secretariat and Chancellery for yellow slip and reading.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required military affairs documents to follow Three Departments procedure through the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛酉，省六合戍兵，以所墾田給還復業之民。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day xinyou, the garrison at Liuhe was reduced, and the fields they had reclaimed were returned to the people who resumed their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two, on the xinyou day, the Liuhe garrison was cut and reclaimed fields returned to returning farmers.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命湖南監司存恤寇盜殘破郡縣。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the Hunan intendants were ordered to succor the prefectures and counties ravaged by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Hunan intendants were ordered to aid counties ravaged by bandits.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，罷盱眙屯田，振兩浙、江東饑。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingchou, the Xuyi military colony was abolished and the hungry of the two Zhe and Jiang East were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the dingchou day, the Xuyi colony was abolished and the hungry in Zhe and Jiangdong were relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸玉津園宴射，遂幸龍井。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, he visited the Jade Ford Garden for archery and banquet, then visited Longjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day he held an archery banquet at Jade Ford Garden, then visited Longjing.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，禁京西、利州路科役保勝義士。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yisi, corvée of the Baosheng Righteous Men in Jingxi and Lizhou circuits was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yisi day, corvée levies on Baosheng Righteous Men in Jingxi and Lizhou were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔戒飭刑獄官。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict admonished officials of the penal offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day an edict admonished penal officials.

sentences.zh: 戊午，殿中侍御史王伯庠請裁定奏薦，詔三省、臺諫集議，具條式以聞。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Palace Attendant Censor Wang Boxiu requested fixed rules for memorial recommendation; an edict ordered the Three Departments and censors to assemble, discuss, and report detailed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day censor Wang Boxiu asked for fixed recommendation rules; the Three Departments and censors were ordered to draft regulations.

sentences.zh: 詔：「縣令非兩任，毋除監察御史；

translations.literal: An edict said: 'A magistrate who has not served two terms may not be made investigating censor;
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: 'A magistrate who has not served two terms may not become investigating censor;

sentences.zh: 非任守臣，毋除郎官。

translations.literal: one who has not served as a defending official may not be made court gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: one who has not served as a defending official may not become court gentleman.

sentences.zh: 著爲令。

translations.literal: This was established as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: This was enacted as law.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，賜禮部進士蕭國梁以下四百九十有三人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Xiao Guoliang and four hundred ninety-three others below him in the Ministry of Rites graduates were given jinshi and other degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day Xiao Guoliang and 493 others received jinshi and lower degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，再增諸州軍離軍添差員闕。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the extra posts for detached assignment outside the armies in all prefectures and armies were again increased.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day extra detached posts in prefectural armies were increased again.

sentences.zh: 辛未，罷洪适右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Hong Shi was dismissed as right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Hong Shi was dismissed as right vice director.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以給事中、權吏部尚書魏𣏌同知樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Wei Qi, Supervising Drafter and Acting Minister of Personnel, was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day supervising drafter and acting personnel minister Wei Qi was made associate military affairs director and acting vice director.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，罷和糴。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, harmonized purchase was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day government grain purchase at fixed prices was abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，以久雨，命侍從、臺諫議刑政所宜以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day wuyin, because of prolonged rain, attendants and censors were ordered to discuss what was fitting in criminal policy and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the wuyin day, prolonged rain brought an edict calling on attendants and censors to report on criminal policy.

sentences.zh: 減大理、三衙、臨安府及浙西州縣雜犯死罪以下囚一等，釋杖以下。
