translations.literal: Prisoners below capital crimes in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Guards, Lin'an Prefecture, and the prefectures and counties of western Zhe had one degree reduced; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: Noncapital prisoners in the Court of Judicial Review, Three Guards, Lin'an, and western Zhe were reduced one degree; those below the rod were freed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔兩浙漕臣王炎開平江、湖、秀圍田。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, an edict ordered the Zhe transport commissioner Wang Yan to open polder fields in Pingjiang, Hu, and Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day Zhe transport commissioner Wang Yan was ordered to open polders in Pingjiang, Hu, and Xiu.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the Emperor left the hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day the emperor left the hall and cut his meals.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the Great White star was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the Emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day the emperor resumed normal meals in the hall.

sentences.zh: 乙未，汪澈罷。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Wang Che was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Wang Che was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以知荆南府李道憑恃戚里妄作，罷之。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Li Dao, prefect of Jingnan, was dismissed for relying on imperial kinship and acting recklessly.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Jingnan prefect Li Dao was dismissed for abusing imperial kinship.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，張燾薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wushen, Zhang Tao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wushen day, Zhang Tao died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷權借職田。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the temporary borrowing of official fields was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day temporary borrowing of official fields was ended.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，葉顒罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Ye Yong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Ye Yong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 以魏𣏌爲參知政事，右諫議大夫林安宅同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，中書舍人蔣芾簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Wei Qi was made Vice Director; Right Remonstrance Officer Lin Anzhai was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Director; Secretariat Drafter Jiang Fu was made Signing Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Qi was made vice director; right remonstrator Lin Anzhai associate director and acting vice director; secretariat drafter Jiang Fu signing secretary.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Great White star was visible by day and crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Venus was visible by day and crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 禁浙西修築圍田。

translations.literal: The construction of polder fields in western Zhe was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Polder construction in western Zhe was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 罷修建康行宮。

translations.literal: Construction of the traveling palace at Jiankang was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Construction of the Jiankang traveling palace was halted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命監司、守臣預備水旱。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, intendants and prefects were ordered to prepare against flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day intendants and prefects were ordered to prepare for flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，罷兩浙路提舉市舶司。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiaxu, the Zhe Circuit Office for Supervising Maritime Trade was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiaxu day, the Zhe maritime trade office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路監司、帥臣各察守令臧否以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered circuit intendants and military commissioners each to investigate the good and bad conduct of prefects and magistrates and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required intendants and commanders to report on prefects' and magistrates' conduct.

sentences.zh: 丙子，刑部上《乾道新編特旨斷例》。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the Ministry of Punishments presented the Newly Compiled Precedents for Special Imperial Decisions of the Qiandao Era.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day the Punishments Ministry presented the Qiandao Newly Compiled Precedents for Special Decrees.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔制科權罷注疏出題，守臣、監司亦許解送。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict ordered that for the special examination the commentary questions be temporarily suspended and that defending officials and intendants also be permitted to submit candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day an edict suspended commentary questions for the special examination and allowed prefects and intendants to submit candidates.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，封孫挺爲福州觀察使、榮國公，攄爲左千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the grandson Ting was enfeoffed as Observation Commissioner of Fu and Duke of Rong; Shu was made Major General of the Left Thousand Bull Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day grandson Ting was enfeoffed Fuzhou observation commissioner and Duke of Rong; Shu was made major general of the Left Thousand Bull Guard.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔使相毋奏補文資，七色補官人毋任子，堂吏遷朝議大夫以五員爲額。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, an edict ordered that chief ministers not memorialize civil appointments for their sons; persons receiving the seven-color appointment might not secure yin privilege for their sons; transfer of secretariat clerks to Court Gentleman for Discussion was fixed at a quota of five.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day an edict barred chief ministers from civil appointments for sons, yin privilege for seven-color appointees, and capped secretariat clerk promotions at five.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，申嚴內外牒式法，裁其額。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the forms for internal and external documents were strictly enforced and their quotas cut.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day document forms inside and outside court were tightened and quotas cut.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，廢永豐圩。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Yongfeng polder was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the Yongfeng polder was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔改官人實曆知縣一任，方許關升。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an edict ordered that persons changing office must have served one term in fact as magistrate before being permitted to advance by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day an edict required one actual term as magistrate before promotion by memorial.

sentences.zh: 著爲定式。

translations.literal: This was established as a fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: This was fixed as permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，調泉州左翼軍二千人屯許浦鎮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiyou, two thousand men of the Left Wing Army of Quan were transferred to garrison Xupu town.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the jiyou day, two thousand Quan Left Wing troops were posted at Xupu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以鎮江都統制戚方爲武當軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Qi Fang, Commander-in-Chief of Zhenjiang, was made Military Commissioner of Wudang.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Zhenjiang commander Qi Fang was made Wudang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，詔兩淮行鐵錢，銅錢毋過江北。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day of the month xinwei, an edict ordered iron cash used on the two Huai and copper cash not to cross north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon xinwei, an edict made iron cash standard on the Huai and barred copper north of the river.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以武鋒軍隸步軍司。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Martial Valor Army was placed under the Infantry Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day the Martial Valor Army was assigned to the Infantry Office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day.

sentences.zh: 罷任子年三十得免試參選之令。

translations.literal: The statute allowing sons at thirty to avoid examination and enter candidacy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The rule letting sons enter candidacy without examination at thirty was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，蠲淮南放歸萬弩手差役二年。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, corvée for ten thousand crossbowmen released in Huainan was remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day corvée for ten thousand released Huainan crossbowmen was remitted for two years.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔諸州守臣兼訓練禁軍。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict ordered prefects of all prefectures concurrently to train the forbidden troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day an edict required all prefects to train forbidden troops.

sentences.zh: 癸未，降會子、交子於鎮江、建康務場，令江、淮之人對換。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, huizi and jiaozi notes were issued at the Zhenjiang and Jiankang exchange offices for people of the Jiang and Huai to exchange.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day huizi and jiaozi notes were issued at Zhenjiang and Jiankang for Jiang-Huai exchange.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，林安宅劾葉顒之子受金失實，罷之。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Lin Anzhai impeached Ye Yong's son for receiving gold on a false report; Yong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Lin Anzhai impeached Ye Yong's son for taking gold on a false report; Ye Yong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔安宅筠州居住，溫州大水。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict ordered Anzhai to reside at Yun Prefecture; Wen Prefecture suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Anzhai was exiled to Yunzhou; Wenzhou suffered severe flood.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以魏杞兼同知樞密院事，蔣芾權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Wei Qi was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Jiang Fu was Acting Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Wei Qi was made associate military affairs director and Jiang Fu acting vice director.

sentences.zh: 召葉顒。

translations.literal: Ye Yong was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Yong was summoned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，少保、新興郡王吳蓋薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Wu Gai, Junior Guardian and Prince of Xinxing, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day Junior Guardian Wu Gai, Prince of Xinxing, died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，立中興以來十三處戰功格目。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the scale of merit rewards for thirteen battle achievements since the Restoration was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day merit scales were fixed for thirteen Restoration battles.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔吳璘復判興州。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, an edict ordered Wu Lin again to serve as prefect of Xing.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day an edict restored Wu Lin to Xing prefect.

sentences.zh: 丙申，升宣州爲甯國府。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Xuan Prefecture was promoted to Ningguo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Xuanzhou was elevated to Ningguo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 罷戶部諸路歲糴一年。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue's annual grain purchase in all circuits was abolished for one year.
translations.idiomatic: The Revenue Ministry's annual circuit grain purchases were suspended for one year.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，知上元縣李允升犯髒貸死，杖脊刺面，配惠州牢城，籍其貲。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiachen, Li Yunsheng, magistrate of Shangyuan, was guilty of corrupt bribes warranting death; he was beaten on the back, tattooed on the face, sent to Huizhou prison, and his property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiachen day, Shangyuan magistrate Li Yunsheng was sentenced for capital corruption: flogged, tattooed, sent to Huizhou prison, and his property seized.

sentences.zh: 丙午，建康守臣王佐坐縱允升去官，奪三官勒停、建昌軍居住。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Wang Zuo, defending official of Jiankang, was dismissed for letting Yunsheng escape; three ranks were stripped and he was suspended and made to reside at Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Jiankang defender Wang Zuo was dismissed for letting Yunsheng escape; he lost three ranks and was exiled to Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 余失按官吏及薦舉官奪官有差。

translations.literal: The remaining officials who had failed in their duties and the recommending officials had ranks stripped in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Other negligent officials and their recommenders lost ranks in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣官按視溫州水災，振貧民，決系囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, officials were sent to inspect the flood disaster in Wen Prefecture, relieve the poor, and release prisoners on bond.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day officials were sent to inspect Wenzhou's flood, aid the poor, and release prisoners on bond.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔改造大曆。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, an edict ordered the calendar reformed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict ordered calendar reform.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，追封子恪爲邵王，諡曰悼肅。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the son Ke was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shao; his posthumous title was Mourning and Solemn.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day the son Ke was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Shao with the posthumous name Mourning and Solemn.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔監司各舉部內知縣、縣令二三人，守臣各舉屬縣一二人。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an edict ordered each intendant to recommend two or three prefects and magistrates within his jurisdiction, and each defending official one or two magistrates in his subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day each intendant was to nominate two or three prefects or magistrates and each defender one or two county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 己巳，魏𣏌等上神宗、哲宗、徽宗三朝《帝紀》、《太上皇聖政》。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Wei Qi and others presented the Imperial Annals and Sagely Governance of the Retired Emperor for the three reigns of Emperor Shenzong, Emperor Zhezong, and Emperor Huizong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Wei Qi and others presented the annals and retired emperor's sagely governance for Shenzong, Zhezong, and Huizong.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: The Great White star was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔舉將帥，置章奏簿。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered the recommendation of generals and the establishment of a memorial register.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict called for general nominations and a memorial register.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，上《太上皇聖政》于德壽宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guiyou, the Sagely Governance of the Retired Emperor was presented at the Palace of Virtuous Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the guiyou day, the Retired Emperor's Sagely Governance was presented at his palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣薛良朋等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Xue Liangpeng and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Xue Liangpeng and others were sent to the Jin court for New Year greetings.

sentences.zh: 己卯，減饒州歲貢金三之一，蠲諸路灑坊逋賦。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Rao Prefecture's annual gold tribute was reduced by one third, and the arrears of wine shops in all circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Raozhou's annual gold tribute was cut by a third and wine-shop arrears empire-wide were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊子，知峽州呂令問坐縱髒吏知夷陵縣韓贄胄去官，奪二官、鄂州居住。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Lü Lingwen, prefect of Xia, was dismissed for allowing the corrupt official Han Zanzhou, magistrate of Yiling, to leave office; two ranks were stripped and he was made to reside at E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Xia prefect Lü Lingwen was dismissed for letting corrupt Yiling magistrate Han Zanzhou flee; he lost two ranks and was exiled to Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 金遣魏子平等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: The Jin sent Wei Ziping and others to congratulate the Festival of Accumulated Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin sent Wei Ziping and others to congratulate the Festival of Accumulated Celebration.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，楊存中薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingwu, Yang Cunzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingwu day, Yang Cunzhong died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，盡出內藏及南庫銀以易會子，官司並以錢銀支遣，民間從便。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, all silver from the inner treasury and the southern vault was released to exchange for huizi notes; government offices were all to disburse in cash and silver, for the convenience of the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day inner-treasury and southern-vault silver was released to exchange for huizi; government offices were to pay in cash and silver for the people's convenience.

sentences.zh: 兩淮總領所許自造會子。

translations.literal: The chief administration offices of the two Huai were permitted to issue huizi notes on their own.
translations.idiomatic: The two Huai chief administration offices were allowed to issue huizi on their own.

sentences.zh: 鬻諸路營田。

translations.literal: Military colonies in all circuits were sold off.
translations.idiomatic: Military colonies in all circuits were sold.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔修祥曦殿記注。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict ordered the compilation of the record and commentary on the Hall of Auspicious Dawn.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day an edict ordered compilation of the Hall of Auspicious Dawn annals.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，密詔四川制置使汪應辰：如吳璘不起，收其宣撫使牌印，權行主管職事。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, a secret edict to Wang Yingchen, Commissioner for Arrangement of Sichuan: if Wu Lin would not take office, his pacification commissioner seals and tallies were to be taken and his duties temporarily performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day a secret edict to Sichuan commissioner Wang Yingchen: if Wu Lin refused office, seize his seals and act in his place.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, a great review of troops was held.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day a grand troop review was held.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，築郢州城。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the walls of Ying Prefecture were built.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day Yingzhou's walls were built.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔汰冗兵。

translations.literal: That month, an edict ordered the elimination of redundant soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict ordered redundant troops cut.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午朔，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day of the month gengwu, white vapor stretched across the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the new moon gengwu, white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔三省、侍從、台諫、兩淮漕臣、郡守，條具兩淮鐵錢、交子利害以聞。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, an edict ordered the Three Departments, attendants, censors, Huai transport commissioners, and prefects to list the benefits and harms of iron cash and jiaozi notes on the two Huai and report.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day an edict required the Three Departments, attendants, censors, Huai transport commissioners, and prefects to report on iron cash and jiaozi on the Huai.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣梁克家等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Liang Kejia and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day Liang Kejia and others were sent to congratulate the Jin emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以資政殿學士葉顒知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Ye Yong, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, was made Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day Assisting Governance academician Ye Yong was made military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔免進呈《欽宗日曆》，送國史院修纂實錄。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, an edict ordered exemption from presenting the Calendar of Emperor Qinzong and its transfer to the Historiography Office for compilation of the Veritable Record.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day an edict waived presentation of Emperor Qinzong's calendar and sent it to the Historiography Office for the veritable record.

sentences.zh: 壬午，追封楊存中爲和王。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Yang Cunzhong was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of He.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Yang Cunzhong was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of He.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以葉顒爲尚書左僕射，魏杞右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Ye Yong was made Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Wei Qi Right Vice Director, both Associate Directors of the Secretariat and Chancellery and Commissioners of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Ye Yong was made left personnel vice director and Wei Qi right vice director, both associate secretariat directors and military affairs commissioners.

sentences.zh: 蔣芾參知政事，吏部尚書陳俊卿同知樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Jiang Fu was made Vice Director; Chen Junqing, Minister of Personnel, was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Fu was made vice director; personnel minister Chen Junqing was made associate military affairs director and acting vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔宰相領兼制國用使，參知政事同知國用事。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, an edict ordered the chief minister to head concurrently the office for controlling state expenditures and the vice director to know state expenditure affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day an edict made the chief minister head state expenditure control and the vice director oversee expenditure affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔監司、守臣舉廉吏。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, an edict ordered intendants and prefects to recommend incorrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day an edict called on intendants and prefects to nominate honest officials.

sentences.zh: 丙申，金遣烏古論元忠等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Jin sent Wugulun Yuanzhong and others to congratulate the New Year of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the Jin sent Wugulun Yuanzhong and others to greet the coming New Year.

sentences.zh: 以江東兵馬鈐轄王抃爲帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Wang Bian, Military Commander of Jiang East, was given charge of imperial equipage.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang East military commander Wang Bian was given charge of imperial equipage.

sentences.zh: 是歲，裁定內外軍額。

translations.literal: That year, the establishment of armies within and without the court was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: That year troop establishments inside and outside court were fixed.
